Public site design — set like a dataset, homepage, summaries, search\nstate:\tOPEN\nauthor:\tDavelleAT (Davelle Ampofo-Twumasi)\nlabels:\tspec\ncomments:\t0\nassignees:\t\nprojects:\t\nmilestone:\t\nissue-type:\t\nparent:\t\nsub-issues:\t\nsub-issues-completed:\t\nblocked-by:\t\nblocking:\t\nnumber:\t22\n--\n## Problem Statement\n\nThe public site works, but it has no design. It is about 20 lines of CSS in `app/public_site.py`: one 42rem column, the system font, browser-blue links, and a homepage that is just a list of titles. A visitor can't tell what the office publishes, which numbers matter, or how recent they are. Compared with what a WordPress theme gives an office on day one, it looks unfinished. The office also has no way to change its homepage, no summary to show under a title in a list or in a shared link, and no search.\n\nGoal: a public site that looks considered and distinctive, reads well on a phone, and is clearly a college's official data office. Plus the three things a WordPress site gets without effort: an editable homepage, summaries, and search.\n\n## Solution\n\nA visual design, **\"set like a dataset\"**, approved from a mockup in session 22 (screenshots in the closing comment of T19):\n\n- **Type:** Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for text and Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono for figures and labels. The Braille Institute designed them so 0/O and 1/l/I can't be confused, which suits a site of numbers. Self-hosted `.woff2`, OFL.\n- **Colour:** Kenyon purple `#4B2E84` and Kenyon bright purple `#8F80FF` (Kenyon brand guide), a deep purple field `#231443` with a faint plotting grid behind the header, and a single citron accent `#D6F550` used **only** on the purple field. Paper `#FBFAFD`. A full dark mode.\n- **Structure:** numbered navigation (`01 Factbook`), numbered home sections, ISO dates (`2026-09-29`), Reports listed in a real table, and an item's title, summary, and facts set on the purple field above its body.\n- **Charts:** the existing drawn Charts (T16), recoloured. The last series, the newest, is Kenyon purple and earlier series are bright purple. A single series is Kenyon purple.\n\nAnd three features:\n\n- A **Summary** on every Data Bite and Report, shown under its title, in lists, and in link previews.\n- **Homepage settings** the Director edits: the headline, the intro, and up to four **Key figures**. The homepage also features the latest Data Bite with its first Chart.\n- **Site search**, entirely static: `cms publish` writes an index of published titles and summaries, and a small script searches it.\n\nThe admin console keeps today's look. Its redesign is a later spec.\n\n## User Stories\n\n1. As a visitor, I want the homepage to show the college's key figures first, so that I get the most-asked numbers without clicking.\n2. As a visitor, I want to see the latest Data Bite and its chart on the homepage, so that I know what's new and current.\n3. As a visitor, I want Reports listed with what each covers, when it was updated, and whether it's a PDF, so that I can pick the right one at a glance.\n4. As a visitor, I want every Data Bite and Report to have a one- or two-sentence summary under its title and in lists, so that I can tell items apart without opening them.\n5. As a visitor sharing a link, I want the preview in Slack, email, or social media to show the item's title and summary, so that the link is self-explanatory.\n6. As a visitor, I want to search Reports and Data Bites by title and summary, so that I can find \"retention\" without browsing.\n7. As a visitor on a phone, I want every page readable at 390 px with nothing scrolling sideways except a wide table or the nav, so that the site works where most people read it.\n8. As a visitor with low vision or using a keyboard, I want legible type, AA contrast, a skip link, and a visible focus ring, so that I can use the site.\n9. As a visitor using dark mode, I want the site to follow it, so that it isn't a white flash at night.\n10. As a visitor who follows a broken link, I want a site-styled \"page not found\" with a way home, not GitHub's default.\n11. As a visitor printing a Report, I want a clean black-on-white printout without the nav or the purple header.\n12. As the Director, I want to change the homepage headline, intro, and key figures in the console, so that the homepage changes with the census, not with a code change.\n13. As an Analyst or Director, I want to write a summary when I edit an item, with a length limit shown as I type, so that summaries stay short.\n14. As an Analyst or Director, I want the Site preview to show the new design, summary included, so that the preview is still the page as published.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n### Shared (ADR-007)\n\n- **No new dependency.** The fonts are static files in `static/fonts/` with their OFL licence. `cms publish` copies them to `site/fonts/`, and the app serves them at `fonts/…`. No CDN: the site must work from a GitHub Pages subfolder with relative paths only (ADR-001).\n- **The stylesheet moves out of Python** into `static/site.css`, served at `style.css` and written there by `cms publish`, as now. `app.public_site.CSS` goes, and every reader of it (the publish step, the stylesheet route, the preview's copy of the site) reads the file.\n- **The admin console gets its own stylesheet**, `static/admin.css`: today's base rules plus every `.admin-*` rule, and the `.content-body`/`.chart-*` rules the Editor and Chart builder need. `base.html` stays the admin layout, and `public/layout.html` becomes a standalone public layout. A public rule must never reach an admin page, and an admin rule must never reach the public site.\n- Class names keep the repo's prefix rule (`.nav-site`, `.figures-home`, `.table-reports`); no bare `.title` or `.status`.\n- **Dates:** ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` everywhere on the public site, in Atkinson Mono.\n\n### T19: Look and feel\n\n- The layout, header, nav, footer, and type described above, on every public page: home, the Data Bites list, the Reports list, a Data Bite, a Report, and a Site preview (banner restyled to match).\n- **Nav:** each published Report in title order, then Data Bites, each numbered `01`, `02`, … in mono. The current page is marked with `aria-current=\"page\"` and a citron underline. On a phone the nav scrolls sideways with a fade at the edge, and never wraps under the header.\n- **Item pages:** breadcrumb, title, and a facts row (Published, Type, a Report's PDF download) on the purple field. The body sits below at a 44rem measure.\n- **Tables (T09) and Charts (T16):** restyled by class only. Hairline rules, mono figures in right-aligned columns, and the series colours above. The Chart text keeps the size its layout assumes (`FONT` in `app/chart_drawing.py`), and a figure is capped at the 40rem width it is drawn for, so its labels don't scale up in a wider column.\n- **Homepage in T19:** the new layout with the content there is today: the latest Data Bites and the Reports. The key figures, headline, and featured Chart wait for T20.\n- **Search box in the header:** not shown until T20.\n- **Accessibility:** skip link, `:focus-visible` ring, `prefers-reduced-motion` respected, and text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 for large text and chart marks) in both themes, checked and recorded.\n- **Print:** a print stylesheet with black on white, no header field, nav, or search, and link URLs not appended (they're relative).\n- **404:** `cms publish` writes `404.html` at the site root, in the site's layout, with a link home. GitHub Pages serves it at *whatever missing URL was asked for*, at any depth, so relative paths in it can't be trusted. It therefore carries `<base href>` set to `CMS_BASE_PATH` (the deployed Pages URL, already in `app/settings.py`). With that unset (local use), it inlines its styles and links to `index.html`, which is right for a miss at the site's top level. T19 extends the crawler's rules to allow exactly this one `<base>` in `404.html`, and records it in ADR-007.\n\n### T20: Homepage, summaries, and search\n\n- **Summary:** a `summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''` column on `data_bites` and `reports` (via `ADDED_COLUMNS`). Plain text, trimmed, at most 200 characters, refused over that with a message by the field. No Markdown, and it's escaped by Jinja like the title. It's on both edit forms under the title, with a live character count. It's optional: an item without one shows nothing in its place.\n- **Where a Summary shows:** under the title on the item page, in the Data Bites list, in the Reports table's \"What it covers\", on the homepage's latest Data Bite, and in `<meta name=\"description\">`, `og:title`, `og:description`, and `og:type`. `og:url` and `og:image` are left out, because they need absolute URLs.\n- **Homepage settings:** a new `homepage` table holding one row: `headline`, `headline_accent` (the part shown in bright purple), `intro`, and up to four key figures, each with a `value`, a `label`, and a `note` (e.g. \"1,805\" / \"Students enrolled\" / \"Fall 2026 census\"). All of it is plain text with length limits, escaped. It's edited on a Director-only page, `/admin/homepage`, with a CSRF token, and an Analyst gets 403. It has no draft state: it's settings, not content, so it appears on the next `cms publish` like a nav change does. The fixed Confirmation is \"Homepage saved.\" Defaults are seeded so a fresh site has a sensible homepage.\n- **Featured Data Bite:** the newest published Data Bite, with its Summary and its **first Chart** if its body has one, drawn by the existing chart pipeline. Without a Chart, it shows only its title, Summary, and link.\n- **Reports table:** Report, Summary, Updated (`updated_at` date), and Format (`PDF` if its file can be downloaded, otherwise `WEB`). It stacks into rows on a phone.\n- **Search:**\n  - `cms publish` writes `search-index.json`: published items only, with `kind`, `title`, `summary`, `date`, and a site-relative `path`. Nothing from a draft, not even a title, is in it.\n  - `search.html` plus `static/search.js` (vanilla, no build step, ADR-002) does a case-insensitive, accent-insensitive match on title and summary, ranking title matches first.\n  - The header form is a plain `GET` to `search.html?q=`.\n  - Without JavaScript, `search.html` lists every published item, so the form still leads somewhere useful.\n  - The app serves both files too, so search works in local preview as well.\n- **Glossary:** CONTEXT.md gains **Summary**, **Homepage settings**, **Key figure**, and **Site search**.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\n- Existing tests keep passing. Any test that asserts on today's markup or `public_site.CSS` is updated to the new markup in the same commit, with the reason given.\n- New tests:\n  - The stylesheet and fonts are served and exported, and `site/` contains no root-absolute `href` or `src` (the existing crawler).\n  - No public page links `admin.css`, and no admin page links `site.css`.\n  - The Summary's limit and escaping.\n  - Homepage settings are Director-only and need CSRF.\n  - The search index holds published items only: a draft's title must not appear in it.\n  - The featured Data Bite shows its first Chart, and nothing when it has none.\n  - `404.html` exists in the export.\n- **Browser check** in each closing comment, at 390, 768, and 1440 px (the iframe method in the session notes) in light and dark, with screenshots. Plus a check that the fonts actually loaded (`document.fonts`), not just that they are named in the CSS.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- The admin console's redesign (a later spec).\n- Full-text search of bodies, and a search server.\n- `og:image`, social cards, and analytics.\n- Report categories in the nav.\n- Theme switching or a theme picker in the console.\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- Mockup and fonts from session 22 are in that session's scratchpad. The approved mockup's CSS is the starting point for `static/site.css`.\n- Kenyon brand colours: [Kenyon brand guide](https://www.kenyon.edu/files/resources/brand-guides-brand-08-30-23.pdf).\n\n\n-------\n# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review {"parentUuid":"fedd4fd6-ba35-41c2-9867-872b18443175","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"63823680-50d9-4a07-aebf-dc341064a9d7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01LFQqzHWRtUMi3zpVjEaYmd","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import charts, db, site_links\nfrom app.rendering import parse\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, and body, all three of which the form saves. A hash\n    of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    try:\n        # Every save, from the Editor or not (spec #14, ADR-006).\n        charts.check(parse(body))\n    except charts.ChartError as exc:\n        raise ContentError(str(exc)) from None\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    kind: str   # e.g. \"report\", its site links' scheme (app.site_links)\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft, with a new ref.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                # Held from choosing the ref to storing it (site_links.new_ref).\n                conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id, ref)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id, site_links.new_ref(conn)),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None,\n               base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. With `base`,\n        the item_base the edit form was opened on, StaleItem if the item has\n        changed since, and nothing is written. False if nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                if base is not None:\n                    # Held from the check to the write, so no other save\n                    # lands between them.\n                    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                    row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT title, slug, body FROM {self.table}\"\n                                       \" WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                    if row is not None and item_base(*row) != base:\n                        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Delete the item, leaving its ref's tombstone. False if there is no\n        such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            site_links.tombstone(conn, self.kind, item_id)\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\", \"data-bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite;\n    StaleItem if it has changed since `base` (ContentTable.update).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body, base=base)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\nfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\nremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\nits file and its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\", \"report\")\n_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\nLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n\n    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n        if attach:\n            attach(conn, report_id)\n\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director; StaleItem if it has changed\n    since `base` (ContentTable.update).\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf), base=base):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(report_id):\n        return False\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"08aaf8ce-2fb4-4ee3-b421-908282031f33","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:19:04.455Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"What Data Bites and Reports share: the title/slug/Markdown-body fields, their\nvalidation, the draft/published status, and the table-level reads and writes.\n\nEach content type keeps its own table, so a slug is unique within a type but a\nData Bite and a Report may share one (spec #1, \"Publish gate & export paths\":\nexports are namespaced by type). Who may do what is decided by each type's own\nmodule and routes, not here.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom app import charts, db, site_links\nfrom app.rendering import parse\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"Draft\", \"published\": \"Published\"}\n# Runs inside the transaction that wrote an item's row, given the connection and\n# the item's id; if it raises, the row's change is rolled back with it.\nAlsoWrite = Callable[[sqlite3.Connection, int], None]\n_SLUG_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# A slug names its item's page, <type folder>/<slug>.html, on the public site;\n# <type folder>/index.html is taken by the type's list page.\n_RESERVED_SLUGS = {\"index\"}\n\n\nclass ContentError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Content broke a rule; the message is safe to show.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass DuplicateSlug(ContentError):\n    pass\n\n\nSTALE = \"This item changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.\"\n\n\nclass StaleItem(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"Saved from an edit form opened on an older version of the item.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, and body, all three of which the form saves. A hash\n    of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body]).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef validate(title: str, slug: str, body: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    title, slug = title.strip(), slug.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a title.\")\n    if not _SLUG_PATTERN.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise ContentError(\"Slugs use lowercase letters, digits, and single \"\n                           \"hyphens, e.g. fall-enrollment.\")\n    if slug in _RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise ContentError(f\"The slug {slug} is reserved for the list page; \"\n                           \"choose another.\")\n    if not body.strip():\n        raise ContentError(\"Enter a body.\")\n    try:\n        # Every save, from the Editor or not (spec #14, ADR-006).\n        charts.check(parse(body))\n    except charts.ChartError as exc:\n        raise ContentError(str(exc)) from None\n    return title, slug, body\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentTable:\n    \"\"\"One content type's table. `table` is a fixed identifier from this\n    codebase, never user input.\"\"\"\n    table: str  # e.g. \"reports\"\n    noun: str   # e.g. \"Report\", for messages\n    kind: str   # e.g. \"report\", its site links' scheme (app.site_links)\n\n    def _select(self, where: str, order: str, params: tuple = ()) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT c.*, u.name AS author_name FROM {self.table} c\"\n                f\" JOIN users u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE {where} ORDER BY {order}\",\n                params,\n            ).fetchall()\n\n    def _duplicate_slug_error(self, exc: sqlite3.IntegrityError, slug: str) -> DuplicateSlug:\n        \"\"\"Translate the slug's UNIQUE violation; re-raise any other constraint.\"\"\"\n        if f\"{self.table}.slug\" not in str(exc):\n            raise exc\n        return DuplicateSlug(f\"Another {self.noun} already uses the slug {slug}.\")\n\n    def create(self, title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n               also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> int:\n        \"\"\"Create a draft, with a new ref.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                # Held from choosing the ref to storing it (site_links.new_ref).\n                conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                item_id = conn.execute(\n                    f\"INSERT INTO {self.table} (title, slug, body, author_id, ref)\"\n                    \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, author_id, site_links.new_ref(conn)),\n                ).lastrowid\n                if also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n        return item_id\n\n    def update(self, item_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n               drafts_only: bool = False, also: AlsoWrite | None = None,\n               base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. The author, created_at, and status are\n        kept. With drafts_only, a published item is left alone. With `base`,\n        the item_base the edit form was opened on, StaleItem if the item has\n        changed since, and nothing is written. False if nothing was changed.\"\"\"\n        title, slug, body = validate(title, slug, body)\n        try:\n            with db.connect() as conn:\n                if base is not None:\n                    # Held from the check to the write, so no other save\n                    # lands between them.\n                    conn.execute(\"BEGIN IMMEDIATE\")\n                    row = conn.execute(f\"SELECT title, slug, body FROM {self.table}\"\n                                       \" WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).fetchone()\n                    if row is not None and item_base(*row) != base:\n                        raise StaleItem(STALE)\n                changed = conn.execute(\n                    f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET title = ?, slug = ?, body = ?,\"\n                    \" updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                    \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                    (title, slug, body, item_id, drafts_only),\n                ).rowcount == 1\n                if changed and also:\n                    also(conn, item_id)\n                return changed\n        except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:\n            raise self._duplicate_slug_error(exc, slug) from None\n\n    def touch(self, item_id: int, *, drafts_only: bool = False,\n              also: AlsoWrite | None = None) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Mark the item as changed now, for a change outside its row (e.g.\n        its images), made by `also` in the same transaction. With drafts_only,\n        a published item is left alone, as `update`. False if nothing was\n        changed.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            changed = conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR NOT ?)\",\n                (item_id, drafts_only),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n            if changed and also:\n                also(conn, item_id)\n            return changed\n\n    def get(self, item_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        rows = self._select(\"c.id = ?\", \"c.id\", (item_id,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def list_all(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        \"\"\"Every item, or only those in `status`; most recently updated first.\"\"\"\n        where, params = (\"1\", ()) if status is None else (\"c.status = ?\", (status,))\n        return self._select(where, \"c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC\", params)\n\n    def count_by_status(self) -> dict[str, int]:\n        \"\"\"How many items are in each status, zero included, e.g.\n        {\"draft\": 2, \"published\": 0}.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            rows = conn.execute(\n                f\"SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM {self.table} GROUP BY status\").fetchall()\n        return {**dict.fromkeys(STATUS_LABELS, 0), **dict(rows)}\n\n    def list_published(self, order: str) -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n        return self._select(\"c.status = 'published'\", order)\n\n    def get_published(self, slug: str) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n        \"\"\"The published item with this slug; None for a draft or no such item.\"\"\"\n        rows = self._select(\"c.status = 'published' AND c.slug = ?\", \"c.id\", (slug,))\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def set_status(self, item_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Publish or unpublish. False if there is no such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"UPDATE {self.table} SET status = ?, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n                \" WHERE id = ?\",\n                (status, item_id),\n            ).rowcount == 1\n\n    def delete(self, item_id: int) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Delete the item, leaving its ref's tombstone. False if there is no\n        such item.\"\"\"\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            site_links.tombstone(conn, self.kind, item_id)\n            return conn.execute(\n                f\"DELETE FROM {self.table} WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\"\"\"Data Bites: short, dated Markdown items.\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create, edit, publish, and unpublish any Data Bite,\nand add or remove its chart images (shift continuity, ADR-003, ADR-004); only\na Director may delete one, which the routes enforce. Editing never changes the\nauthor or created_at. Deleting a Data Bite deletes its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Data Bites only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images\nfrom app.content import ContentTable\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"data_bites\", \"Data Bite\", \"data-bite\")\n_IMAGES = \"data-bites\"  # the chart_images kind\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft. It starts with no images, even if a deleted Data Bite\n    that had its id left some behind (SQLite may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id,\n                         also=lambda conn, bite_id: chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id))\n\n\ndef update(bite_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body. False if there is no such Data Bite;\n    StaleItem if it has changed since `base` (ContentTable.update).\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.update(bite_id, title, slug, body, base=base)\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Data Bites only, newest first.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.created_at DESC, c.id DESC\")\n\n\ndef delete(bite_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Data Bite and its images. False if there is no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(bite_id):\n        return False\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(bite_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Data Bite's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, bite_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(bite_id: int, image: chart_images.Image) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image, or replace the one of the same name. False if there\n    is no such Data Bite; ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.touch(bite_id, also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(\n        _IMAGES, item_id, image))\n\n\ndef remove_image(bite_id: int, name: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"False if there is no such Data Bite or it has no image of that name.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(bite_id) or not _TABLE.touch(bite_id):\n        return False\n    return chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, bite_id, name)\n\"\"\"Reports: durable, cite-able Markdown documents (the Factbook, the CDS).\n\nAny Analyst or Director may create a Report (always as a draft) and edit a\ndraft one, whoever started it (shift continuity, ADR-003). Once a Report is\npublished only a Director may change it: `update` enforces that in the same\nstatement that writes, and the routes make publish, unpublish, and delete\nDirector only. Editing never changes the author or created_at.\n\nA Report may carry one attached PDF (checked by app.uploads). Attaching,\nreplacing, or removing it follows the same lockdown as the body. The file is\nstored under settings.UPLOADS, outside site/, named by the Report's id; the\n`file_name` column says whether there is one.\n\nA Report may also carry chart images (app.chart_images, ADR-004), stored apart\nfrom its PDF, so that changing one never touches the other. Adding or\nremoving an image follows the same lockdown again. Deleting a Report deletes\nits file and its images.\n\nPublic-facing code reads Reports only through `list_published` and\n`get_published`, so a draft cannot leak through it.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import chart_images, db, settings\nfrom app.content import AlsoWrite, ContentError, ContentTable\nfrom app.uploads import Pdf, write_atomically\nfrom app.users import is_director\n\n_TABLE = ContentTable(\"reports\", \"Report\", \"report\")\n_IMAGES = \"reports\"  # the chart_images kind\nLOCKED = \"Only the Director can change a published Report.\"\n\nget = _TABLE.get\nlist_all = _TABLE.list_all\ncount_by_status = _TABLE.count_by_status\nset_status = _TABLE.set_status\nget_published = _TABLE.get_published\n\n\nclass ReportLocked(ContentError):\n    \"\"\"A published Report, and the user is not a Director.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef can_edit(report: sqlite3.Row, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"The lockdown rule. `update`, `remove_file`, `add_image`, and\n    `remove_image` apply the same rule in their UPDATEs.\"\"\"\n    return report[\"status\"] == \"draft\" or is_director(user)\n\n\ndef file_path(report_id: int) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where a Report's attached file is stored. Built from the id alone.\"\"\"\n    return settings.UPLOADS / \"reports\" / f\"{int(report_id)}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef _attaching(pdf: Pdf | None) -> AlsoWrite | None:\n    \"\"\"Attach `pdf` in the same transaction as the Report's row, so the body\n    and the file are saved together or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if pdf is None:\n        return None\n\n    def attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE reports SET file_name = ? WHERE id = ?\", (pdf.name, report_id))\n        write_atomically(file_path(report_id), pdf.data)\n\n    return attach\n\n\ndef _missing_or_locked(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"After a guarded write changed nothing: False if there is no such\n    Report, otherwise it was published and locked.\"\"\"\n    if get(report_id) is None:\n        return False\n    raise ReportLocked(LOCKED)\n\n\ndef create(title: str, slug: str, body: str, author_id: int, *,\n           pdf: Pdf | None = None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Create a draft Report, with its file if one is given. It starts with no\n    images, even if a deleted Report that had its id left some behind (SQLite\n    may reuse the highest id).\"\"\"\n    attach = _attaching(pdf)\n\n    def clear_images_then_attach(conn: sqlite3.Connection, report_id: int) -> None:\n        chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n        if attach:\n            attach(conn, report_id)\n\n    return _TABLE.create(title, slug, body, author_id, also=clear_images_then_attach)\n\n\ndef update(report_id: int, title: str, slug: str, body: str, *,\n           user: sqlite3.Row, pdf: Pdf | None = None, base: str | None = None) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Edit title, slug, and body on behalf of `user`, and attach or replace\n    the file if one is given. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked if\n    it is published and `user` is not a Director; StaleItem if it has changed\n    since `base` (ContentTable.update).\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.update(report_id, title, slug, body, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                     also=_attaching(pdf), base=base):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_file(report_id: int, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove the Report's file on behalf of `user`, as `update`.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        removed = conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE reports SET file_name = NULL, updated_at = datetime('now')\"\n            \" WHERE id = ? AND (status = 'draft' OR ?)\",\n            (report_id, is_director(user)),\n        ).rowcount == 1\n    if not removed:\n        return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n    # Only once the row no longer names it, so a failed commit keeps the file.\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    return True\n\n\ndef images(report_id: int) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The Report's chart images, {name: where it is stored}, by name.\"\"\"\n    return chart_images.stored(_IMAGES, report_id)\n\n\ndef add_image(report_id: int, image: chart_images.Image, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Add a chart image on behalf of `user`, or replace the one of the same\n    name. False if there is no such Report; ReportLocked as `update`;\n    ContentError if it already has the most allowed.\"\"\"\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.save(_IMAGES, item_id, image)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef remove_image(report_id: int, name: str, *, user: sqlite3.Row) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Remove a chart image on behalf of `user`. False if there is no such\n    Report or it has no image of that name; ReportLocked as `update`.\"\"\"\n    if name not in images(report_id):\n        return False\n    if _TABLE.touch(report_id, drafts_only=not is_director(user),\n                    also=lambda conn, item_id: chart_images.remove(_IMAGES, item_id, name)):\n        return True\n    return _missing_or_locked(report_id)\n\n\ndef delete(report_id: int) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Delete the Report, its file, and its images. False if there is no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    if not _TABLE.delete(report_id):\n        return False\n    file_path(report_id).unlink(missing_ok=True)\n    chart_images.remove_all(_IMAGES, report_id)\n    return True\n\n\ndef list_published() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"The public-facing query: published Reports only, by title.\"\"\"\n    return _TABLE.list_published(\"c.title, c.id\")","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"7cc4e0c5-3dcf-400f-8095-4c6452b45ffc","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"fedd4fd6-ba35-41c2-9867-872b18443175","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}
