{"parentUuid":"8590e2ac-f09d-4018-8717-db51c2f36092","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"63823680-50d9-4a07-aebf-dc341064a9d7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014Dfd2p9CJnbSJq5yW6S4XV","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings, site_links\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n# The site's stylesheet and the fonts it loads, with their licences (ADR-007).\nSTYLESHEET = settings.STATIC / \"site.css\"\nFONTS = settings.STATIC / \"fonts\"\n# What each kind of asset is served as, by extension; never sniffed.\nASSET_TYPES = {\".css\": \"text/css; charset=utf-8\", \".woff2\": \"font/woff2\",\n               \".txt\": \"text/plain; charset=utf-8\"}\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n    # Where each site link its body may have leads, {site reference: path in\n    # the site}; None for the published items' (published_links).\n    links: Mapping[str, str] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        links = published_links() if self.links is None else self.links\n\n        def link_href(reference: str) -> str | None:\n            path = links.get(reference)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src, link_href=link_href,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, page_path=self.path,\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef published_links() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Where a site link to each published item leads, {site reference: path\n    in the site}. A draft, deleted, or unknown one is not here, so a link to\n    it is its text.\"\"\"\n    return {**{site_links.reference(\"data-bite\", bite[\"ref\"]): data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"])\n               for bite in data_bites.list_published()},\n            **{site_links.reference(\"report\", found[\"ref\"]): report_path(found[\"slug\"])\n               for found in reports.list_published()}}\n\n\ndef _linked_as_published(page: Page, kind: str, item: Mapping) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A Site preview's page, whose item's own site links resolve as if it\n    were published; a new item has no ref yet.\"\"\"\n    links = published_links()\n    if item.get(\"ref\"):\n        links[site_links.reference(kind, item[\"ref\"])] = page.path\n    return replace(page, links=links)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef not_found() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"404.html, which GitHub Pages serves at whatever missing path was asked\n    for, at any depth, so its relative links can't be trusted (ADR-007). It\n    carries a <base> at the deployed site's root, CMS_BASE_PATH. Without one\n    (local use) it inlines its stylesheet and links as from the site's root,\n    which is right for a miss at the top level.\"\"\"\n    base = settings.BASE_PATH\n    if not base.startswith((\"https://\", \"http://\")):\n        base = \"\"  # a path alone would be a root-absolute link (ADR-001)\n    elif not base.endswith(\"/\"):\n        base += \"/\"  # else the <base> is the site's parent folder\n    return Page(\"404.html\", \"public/not_found.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Page not found\", \"site_base\": base,\n                 \"inline_css\": None if base else Markup(STYLESHEET.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))})\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(), not_found(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef assets() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet and its fonts, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}: style.css, and fonts/ beside it with the fonts' OFL licences.\"\"\"\n    return {\"style.css\": STYLESHEET,\n            **{f\"fonts/{font.name}\": font for font in sorted(FONTS.iterdir())\n               if font.suffix in ASSET_TYPES}}\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides assets(), as {path in the\n    site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and Reports' chart\n    images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": now, \"updated_at\": now}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    bite = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    return _linked_as_published(_data_bite_page(bite), \"data-bite\", bite)\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return _linked_as_published(replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav),\n                                \"report\", report)\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in {**public_site.assets(), **public_site.files()}.items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\n\"\"\"The public site, served at the same paths `cms publish` exports it to. No\nlogin: everything here is published content only (app.public_site).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.public_site import Page\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _html(page: Page | None) -> HTMLResponse:\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return HTMLResponse(page.render())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\")\n@router.get(\"/index.html\")\ndef home():\n    return _html(public_site.home())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/404.html\")\ndef not_found():\n    return _html(public_site.not_found())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef stylesheet():\n    return asset(\"style.css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/fonts/{name}\")\ndef font(name: str):\n    return asset(f\"fonts/{name}\")\n\n\ndef asset(path: str) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet, or a font or its licence, at `path` in the site\n    (public_site.assets).\"\"\"\n    stored = public_site.assets().get(path)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return FileResponse(stored, media_type=public_site.ASSET_TYPES[stored.suffix],\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/\")\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/index.html\")\ndef data_bite_list():\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/{slug}.html\")\ndef data_bite(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.data_bite_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/\")\n@router.get(\"/reports/index.html\")\ndef report_list():\n    return _html(public_site.report_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/{slug}.html\")\ndef report(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.report(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/reports/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.report_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/files/{slug}.pdf\")\ndef report_file(slug: str):\n    found = public_site.report_file(slug)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return pdf_response(*found)\n\n\ndef pdf_response(path: Path, name: str | None = None) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A Report's stored file, served as a PDF and never sniffed as anything\n    else; downloaded as `name` if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\", filename=name,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\"\"\"A Site preview's own copy of the site, which the Data Bite and Report\nadmin routes serve under their login at /admin/<type>/<id>/preview/ (and\n/admin/<type>/preview/ for a new item). A Site preview's links are relative\nand resolve there (app.public_site.Page.render_preview).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.routes.public import asset, pdf_response\n\n# A path in the site, as the *_path functions of app.public_site make them:\n# never starting with \"/\" or a backslash, so a redirect to \"/\" + it stays on\n# this site.\n_SITE_PATH = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*\", re.ASCII)\n\n\ndef site_file(path: str, images: dict[str, Path], pdfs: dict[str, Path] | None = None) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"What a Site preview's link to `path` in the site gets: the stylesheet\n    or a font (public_site.assets), or one of the previewed item's own chart\n    `images` or `pdfs` (a Report's file), by path in the site, which the\n    public site would not serve for a draft. Any other page sends the browser\n    to the published one.\"\"\"\n    if path in public_site.assets():\n        return asset(path)\n    if path in images:\n        return chart_images.response(images[path])\n    if pdfs and path in pdfs:\n        return pdf_response(pdfs[path])\n    if not _SITE_PATH.fullmatch(path):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/\" + path, status_code=303)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"7c908b97-c039-4dc2-b0bf-2ce2f0b29f29","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:19:04.460Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The public site: every page a visitor can see, each described by the path\nit has in the exported site (e.g. \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").\n\nThe app serves these pages at those same paths (app.routes.public), and\n`cms publish` writes them there (app.publish), so the two render one set of pages\nrather than two. Pages link to each other relatively, through `root` (\"\" at\nthe top of the site, \"../\" one folder down), so the same HTML works served\nfrom / and exported to a GitHub Pages subfolder. Where each kind of page or\nfile sits is decided here, by the *_path functions, and nowhere else.\n\nContent is read only through the published-only queries (`list_published`,\n`get_published`), so a draft cannot reach a page, a link, or the navigation.\nThe one exception is a Site preview (`data_bite_preview`, `report_preview`),\nwhich the admin console renders for one item, as if it were published, and\nwhich is never written to the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import ModuleType\n\nfrom markupsafe import Markup\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings, site_links\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n# The site's stylesheet and the fonts it loads, with their licences (ADR-007).\nSTYLESHEET = settings.STATIC / \"site.css\"\nFONTS = settings.STATIC / \"fonts\"\n# What each kind of asset is served as, by extension; never sniffed.\nASSET_TYPES = {\".css\": \"text/css; charset=utf-8\", \".woff2\": \"font/woff2\",\n               \".txt\": \"text/plain; charset=utf-8\"}\nRECENT_DATA_BITES = 5  # on the home page; the rest are on the Data Bites list\n# A new item's slug in its Site preview, which only its paths use.\n_UNSAVED_SLUG = \"untitled\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"data-bites/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef data_bite_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\ndef report_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    return f\"reports/{slug}.html\"\n\n\ndef report_file_path(slug: str) -> str:\n    # .pdf, not the upload's own extension: a Report's file is always a PDF (T05).\n    return f\"reports/files/{slug}.pdf\"\n\n\ndef report_image_path(slug: str, name: str) -> str:\n    return f\"images/reports/{slug}/{name}\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    path: str      # where the page sits in the site, relative to its root\n    template: str\n    context: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The chart images its body may show, {name: path in the site}.\n    images: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)\n    # The Reports in its navigation; None for the published ones.\n    nav_reports: list[Mapping] | None = None\n    # Where each site link its body may have leads, {site reference: path in\n    # the site}; None for the published items' (published_links).\n    links: Mapping[str, str] | None = None\n\n    def render(self) -> str:\n        return self._render(preview_base=None)\n\n    def render_preview(self, at: str) -> str:\n        \"\"\"The page as a Site preview, served from `at`: the root of the\n        preview's own copy of the site, an admin path ending in \"/\". Its links\n        stay relative, as in the export, and a <base> puts the page at its\n        path under `at`, where they reach the preview's stylesheet and files.\n        It shows the \"Draft preview, not published\" banner.\"\"\"\n        return self._render(preview_base=f\"{at}{self.path}\")\n\n    def _render(self, *, preview_base: str | None) -> str:\n        root = \"../\" * self.path.count(\"/\")\n\n        def image_src(name: str) -> str | None:\n            path = self.images.get(name)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        links = published_links() if self.links is None else self.links\n\n        def link_href(reference: str) -> str | None:\n            path = links.get(reference)\n            return None if path is None else f\"{root}{path}\"\n\n        nav_reports = reports.list_published() if self.nav_reports is None else self.nav_reports\n        return templates.env.get_template(self.template).render(\n            image_src=image_src, link_href=link_href,\n            title=settings.SITE_TITLE, root=root, page_path=self.path,\n            home_path=f\"{root}index.html\", nav_reports=nav_reports,\n            data_bite_path=data_bite_path, report_path=report_path,\n            report_file_path=report_file_path, preview_base=preview_base, **self.context)\n\n\ndef published_links() -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Where a site link to each published item leads, {site reference: path\n    in the site}. A draft, deleted, or unknown one is not here, so a link to\n    it is its text.\"\"\"\n    return {**{site_links.reference(\"data-bite\", bite[\"ref\"]): data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"])\n               for bite in data_bites.list_published()},\n            **{site_links.reference(\"report\", found[\"ref\"]): report_path(found[\"slug\"])\n               for found in reports.list_published()}}\n\n\ndef _linked_as_published(page: Page, kind: str, item: Mapping) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A Site preview's page, whose item's own site links resolve as if it\n    were published; a new item has no ref yet.\"\"\"\n    links = published_links()\n    if item.get(\"ref\"):\n        links[site_links.reference(kind, item[\"ref\"])] = page.path\n    return replace(page, links=links)\n\n\ndef home() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"index.html\", \"public/home.html\",\n                {\"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()[:RECENT_DATA_BITES]})\n\n\ndef data_bite_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"data-bites/index.html\", \"public/data_bites.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Data Bites\", \"data_bites\": data_bites.list_published()})\n\n\ndef data_bite(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Data Bite's page; None for a draft or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else _data_bite_page(bite)\n\n\ndef _data_bite_page(bite: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(data_bite_path(bite[\"slug\"]), \"public/data_bite.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": bite[\"title\"], \"bite\": bite},\n                images={name: data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(data_bites, bite)})\n\n\ndef _stored_images(module: ModuleType, item: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Data Bite's or Report's chart images (`module` is its type's),\n    {name: where it is stored}; none for one not yet saved.\"\"\"\n    return {} if item[\"id\"] is None else module.images(item[\"id\"])\n\n\ndef data_bite_files(bite: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The files a Data Bite's page links to, its chart images, as {path in\n    the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {data_bite_image_path(bite[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(data_bites, bite).items()}\n\n\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Data Bite's chart image, at\n    data_bite_image_path(slug, name) in the site, is stored. None for a\n    draft, no such image, or no such Data Bite.\"\"\"\n    bite = data_bites.get_published(slug)\n    return None if bite is None else data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef report_list() -> Page:\n    return Page(\"reports/index.html\", \"public/reports.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Reports\", \"reports\": reports.list_published()})\n\n\ndef _stored_file(report: Mapping) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where the Report's file is stored, if it has one and it is there.\"\"\"\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None:\n        return None\n    stored = reports.file_path(report[\"id\"])\n    return stored if stored.is_file() else None\n\n\ndef report(slug: str) -> Page | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's page, linking its file only if that can be\n    downloaded; None for a draft or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else _report_page(found)\n\n\ndef _report_page(found: Mapping) -> Page:\n    return Page(report_path(found[\"slug\"]), \"public/report.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": found[\"title\"], \"report\": found,\n                 \"has_file\": _stored_file(found) is not None},\n                images={name: report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name)\n                        for name in _stored_images(reports, found)})\n\n\ndef report_image_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's chart images, as {path in the site: where it is stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {report_image_path(found[\"slug\"], name): path\n            for name, path in _stored_images(reports, found).items()}\n\n\ndef report_pdf_file(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"A Report's file, if its page links to it (it can be downloaded), as\n    {path in the site: where it is stored}; empty if not.\"\"\"\n    stored = _stored_file(found)\n    return {report_file_path(found[\"slug\"]): stored} if stored else {}\n\n\ndef report_files(found: Mapping) -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file a Report's page links to, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}.\"\"\"\n    return {**report_image_files(found), **report_pdf_file(found)}\n\n\ndef report_file(slug: str) -> tuple[Path, str] | None:\n    \"\"\"A published Report's attached file, at report_file_path(slug) in the\n    site, as (where it is stored, its display name). None for a draft, a\n    Report with no file, or no such Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    stored = found and _stored_file(found)\n    return (stored, found[\"file_name\"]) if stored else None\n\n\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"Where a published Report's chart image, at report_image_path(slug,\n    name) in the site, is stored. None for a draft, no such image, or no such\n    Report.\"\"\"\n    found = reports.get_published(slug)\n    return None if found is None else reports.images(found[\"id\"]).get(name)\n\n\ndef not_found() -> Page:\n    \"\"\"404.html, which GitHub Pages serves at whatever missing path was asked\n    for, at any depth, so its relative links can't be trusted (ADR-007). It\n    carries a <base> at the deployed site's root, CMS_BASE_PATH. Without one\n    (local use) it inlines its stylesheet and links as from the site's root,\n    which is right for a miss at the top level.\"\"\"\n    base = settings.BASE_PATH\n    if not base.startswith((\"https://\", \"http://\")):\n        base = \"\"  # a path alone would be a root-absolute link (ADR-001)\n    elif not base.endswith(\"/\"):\n        base += \"/\"  # else the <base> is the site's parent folder\n    return Page(\"404.html\", \"public/not_found.html\",\n                {\"page_title\": \"Page not found\", \"site_base\": base,\n                 \"inline_css\": None if base else Markup(STYLESHEET.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))})\n\n\ndef pages() -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every page of the site: what `cms publish` writes.\"\"\"\n    return [home(), data_bite_list(), report_list(), not_found(),\n            *map(_data_bite_page, data_bites.list_published()),\n            *map(_report_page, reports.list_published())]\n\n\ndef assets() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet and its fonts, as {path in the site: where it is\n    stored}: style.css, and fonts/ beside it with the fonts' OFL licences.\"\"\"\n    return {\"style.css\": STYLESHEET,\n            **{f\"fonts/{font.name}\": font for font in sorted(FONTS.iterdir())\n               if font.suffix in ASSET_TYPES}}\n\n\ndef files() -> dict[str, Path]:\n    \"\"\"Every file the site's pages link to besides assets(), as {path in the\n    site: where it is stored}: the published Data Bites' and Reports' chart\n    images, and the published Reports' files.\"\"\"\n    found: dict[str, Path] = {}\n    for bite in data_bites.list_published():\n        found.update(data_bite_files(bite))\n    for report in reports.list_published():\n        found.update(report_files(report))\n    return found\n\n\n# Site previews: one item's page, as if it were published, with unsaved edits.\n\ndef _as_if_published(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"The item a Site preview shows: `saved` (None for a new item, dated now)\n    with `form`'s unsaved title and body, published. It keeps the saved slug:\n    an unsaved slug would change only paths, which no reader sees, and with\n    the saved one the preview finds the item's files where it puts them.\"\"\"\n    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\")\n    item = dict(saved) if saved is not None else {\n        \"id\": None, \"slug\": _UNSAVED_SLUG, \"file_name\": None,\n        \"created_at\": now, \"updated_at\": now}\n    return {**item, \"title\": form[\"title\"].strip(), \"body\": form[\"body\"],\n            \"status\": \"published\"}\n\n\ndef data_bite_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to the Data Bite `saved` (None on\n    the create page). Render it with Page.render_preview.\"\"\"\n    bite = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    return _linked_as_published(_data_bite_page(bite), \"data-bite\", bite)\n\n\ndef report_preview(form: Mapping[str, str], saved: sqlite3.Row | None) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"As data_bite_preview, for a Report. The Report is in the navigation,\n    in title order, as if published; every other draft is not.\"\"\"\n    report = _as_if_published(form, saved)\n    others = [found for found in reports.list_published() if found[\"id\"] != report[\"id\"]]\n    # The order reports.list_published gives (title, then id), the new one last.\n    nav = sorted([*others, report],\n                 key=lambda found: (found[\"title\"], found[\"id\"] is None, found[\"id\"] or 0))\n    return _linked_as_published(replace(_report_page(report), nav_reports=nav),\n                                \"report\", report)\n\"\"\"`cms publish`: write the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe pages and files come from app.public_site, the same ones the app serves,\nat the same paths, so the export is the live public site rather than a second\nrendering of it. That module reads only published content and links only\nrelatively, which gives the two rules the rubric checks here:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"reports/x.html\"), never\n     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport shutil\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Regenerate `out` (site/ by default) from scratch, so a page taken down\n    since the last publish is gone from it too.\"\"\"\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    for page in public_site.pages():\n        # UTF-8, as the app serves them, whatever this machine's locale.\n        _target(out, page.path).write_text(page.render(), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    for path, stored in {**public_site.assets(), **public_site.files()}.items():\n        shutil.copyfile(stored, _target(out, path))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _target(out: Path, path: str) -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Where `path` in the site goes under `out`, its folder made.\"\"\"\n    target = out / path\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    return target\n\"\"\"The public site, served at the same paths `cms publish` exports it to. No\nlogin: everything here is published content only (app.public_site).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.public_site import Page\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef _html(page: Page | None) -> HTMLResponse:\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return HTMLResponse(page.render())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/\")\n@router.get(\"/index.html\")\ndef home():\n    return _html(public_site.home())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/404.html\")\ndef not_found():\n    return _html(public_site.not_found())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/style.css\")\ndef stylesheet():\n    return asset(\"style.css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/fonts/{name}\")\ndef font(name: str):\n    return asset(f\"fonts/{name}\")\n\n\ndef asset(path: str) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"The stylesheet, or a font or its licence, at `path` in the site\n    (public_site.assets).\"\"\"\n    stored = public_site.assets().get(path)\n    if stored is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return FileResponse(stored, media_type=public_site.ASSET_TYPES[stored.suffix],\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/\")\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/index.html\")\ndef data_bite_list():\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/data-bites/{slug}.html\")\ndef data_bite(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.data_bite(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/data-bites/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef data_bite_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.data_bite_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/\")\n@router.get(\"/reports/index.html\")\ndef report_list():\n    return _html(public_site.report_list())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/{slug}.html\")\ndef report(slug: str):\n    return _html(public_site.report(slug))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/images/reports/{slug}/{name}\")\ndef report_image(slug: str, name: str):\n    path = public_site.report_image(slug, name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/reports/files/{slug}.pdf\")\ndef report_file(slug: str):\n    found = public_site.report_file(slug)\n    if found is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return pdf_response(*found)\n\n\ndef pdf_response(path: Path, name: str | None = None) -> FileResponse:\n    \"\"\"A Report's stored file, served as a PDF and never sniffed as anything\n    else; downloaded as `name` if one is given.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\", filename=name,\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\"\"\"A Site preview's own copy of the site, which the Data Bite and Report\nadmin routes serve under their login at /admin/<type>/<id>/preview/ (and\n/admin/<type>/preview/ for a new item). A Site preview's links are relative\nand resolve there (app.public_site.Page.render_preview).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import HTTPException\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response\n\nfrom app import chart_images, public_site\nfrom app.routes.public import asset, pdf_response\n\n# A path in the site, as the *_path functions of app.public_site make them:\n# never starting with \"/\" or a backslash, so a redirect to \"/\" + it stays on\n# this site.\n_SITE_PATH = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*\", re.ASCII)\n\n\ndef site_file(path: str, images: dict[str, Path], pdfs: dict[str, Path] | None = None) -> Response:\n    \"\"\"What a Site preview's link to `path` in the site gets: the stylesheet\n    or a font (public_site.assets), or one of the previewed item's own chart\n    `images` or `pdfs` (a Report's file), by path in the site, which the\n    public site would not serve for a draft. Any other page sends the browser\n    to the published one.\"\"\"\n    if path in public_site.assets():\n        return asset(path)\n    if path in images:\n        return chart_images.response(images[path])\n    if pdfs and path in pdfs:\n        return pdf_response(pdfs[path])\n    if not _SITE_PATH.fullmatch(path):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/\" + path, status_code=303)","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"7cc4e0c5-3dcf-400f-8095-4c6452b45ffc","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8590e2ac-f09d-4018-8717-db51c2f36092","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

\"set like a dataset\" (spec #22, ADR-007). Standalone:\n   the admin console's layout is base.html, and neither links the other's\n   stylesheet. Links are relative to the site's root via `root`, never\n   root-absolute, so the pages work exported to a Pages subfolder.\n\n   Two pages carry a <base>: a Site preview (`preview_base`,\n   app.public_site.Page.render_preview), which also shows its banner, and\n   404.html (`site_base`, app.public_site.not_found), which GitHub Pages\n   serves at whatever path was missed. Without a site_base, 404.html inlines\n   its stylesheet (`inline_css`) instead of linking it. #}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import index_number with context %}\n{%- set base_href = preview_base or site_base -%}\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- if base_href %}\n  <base href=\"{{ base_href }}\">{% endif %}\n  <title>{% if page_title %}{{ page_title }} · {% endif %}{{ title }}</title>\n  {%- if inline_css %}\n  <style>{{ inline_css }}</style>\n  {%- else %}\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ root }}style.css\">\n  {%- endif %}\n</head>\n<body>\n  {#- Under a <base>, \"#main\" resolves against it, not this page. 404.html's\n      <base> is the site's root, so it skips to 404.html#main, the same page\n      at its own path. A Site preview, in a sandboxed frame in the console,\n      has none. #}\n  {%- if not preview_base %}\n  <a class=\"skip-link\" href=\"{{ '404.html' if site_base }}#main\">Skip to content</a>\n  {%- endif %}\n  <div class=\"field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n    {%- if preview_base %}\n    <p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">Draft preview, not published</p>{% endif %}\n    <header class=\"header-site\">\n      <a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path }}\"><span class=\"header-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span><b class=\"header-home-text\">{{ title }}</b></a>\n    </header>\n    <nav class=\"nav-site\" aria-label=\"Site\"><ul>\n      {%- for report in nav_reports %}{% set path = report_path(report.slug) %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}{{ path }}\"{% if path == page_path %} aria-current=\"page\"{% endif %}>{{ index_number(loop.index) }}{{ report.title }}</a></li>\n      {%- endfor %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}data-bites/index.html\"\n        {%- if page_path == \"data-bites/index.html\" %} aria-current=\"page\"\n        {%- elif page_path.startswith(\"data-bites/\") %} aria-current=\"true\"{% endif %}>{{ index_number(nav_reports | length + 1) }}Data Bites</a></li>\n    </ul></nav>\n  </div></div>\n  <main id=\"main\">\n    {%- block field %}{% endblock %}\n    <div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n      {%- block content %}{% endblock %}\n    </div>\n  </main>\n  <footer class=\"footer-site field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n    <div><b>{{ title }}</b><p>The college's official source for enrollment, outcomes and survey data. Each figure is final as of the date shown with it.</p></div>\n    <div><span class=\"text-label\">Data requests</span><p><a href=\"mailto:ir@example.edu\">ir@example.edu</a></p></div>\n    <div><span class=\"text-label\">Location</span><p>Kenyon College<br>Gambier, Ohio</p></div>\n    {#- The fonts' OFL licences travel with them (ADR-007). #}\n    <p class=\"footer-colophon text-label\">Set in Atkinson Hyperlegible <a href=\"{{ root }}fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-next.txt\">Next</a> and <a href=\"{{ root }}fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.txt\">Mono</a>, under the SIL Open Font License</p>\n  </div></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/public/not_found.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import title_field, fact with context %}\n{% block field %}\n  {%- call title_field([(home_path, \"Home\")], \"Page not found\") %}\n    {%- call fact(\"Status\") %}<span class=\"text-mono\">404</span>{% endcall %}\n  {%- endcall %}\n{%- endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n      <div class=\"body-item\">\n        <p>Nothing is published at this address. The page may have been taken down, or the link may be mistyped.</p>\n        <p><a href=\"{{ home_path }}\">Go to the home page</a></p>\n      </div>\n{%- endblock %}\n=== enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"{% endif %}>\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    {%- if form.item_base %}\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"item_base\" value=\"{{ form.item_base }}\">\n    {%- endif %}\n    <div class=\"admin-content-fields\">\n    <p><label>Title <input type=\"text\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><label>Slug <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\" aria-describedby=\"slug-hint\"></label>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small></p>\n    {#- The Editor (app.editor, static/editor.js) takes over the textarea, and\n        shows the body from the template below, which a browser never renders\n        itself. If its script doesn't run, the textarea posts Markdown, each\n        part the Editor can't edit standing as its locked-<n> line. An edit\n        page lists the item's chart images for \"Insert image\"; a create page\n        has no item to hold any yet, and lists none. #}\n    <div class=\"admin-editor\" data-body-dirty=\"{{ 1 if form.body_dirty else 0 }}\"\n      data-site-items='{{ site_items | tojson }}' data-link-states='{{ link_states | tojson }}'\n      {%- if body_images is defined %} data-images='{{ body_images | tojson }}'{% endif %}\n      data-chart-preview=\"{{ path_for('preview_chart') }}\">\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\" required>{{ form.body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    <template class=\"admin-editor-content\">{{ editor_html }}</template>\n    </div>\n    {% if file_label %}\n    <p><label>{{ file_label }}\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\"></label></p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    </div>\n    {#- After the save button, so Enter in a field still saves: the form's\n        first submit button is the one Enter presses. #}\n    {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n  </form>\n  <script src=\"{{ path_for('editor_script') }}\" defer></script>\n=== templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        // The title, the body's textarea, or the Editor (static/editor.js).\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)\n            && !event.target.closest(\".admin-editor-area\")) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\", \"body_html\", \"body_dirty\"]) {\n            const field = form.elements[name];\n            if (field && !field.disabled) data.append(name, field.value);\n          }\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n=== templates/admin/data_bite_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_bites') }}\">All Data Bites</a></p>\n  <h1>Edit Data Bite</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[bite.status] }}. \"set like a dataset\" (spec #22, ADR-007). Standalone:\n   the admin console's layout is base.html, and neither links the other's\n   stylesheet. Links are relative to the site's root via `root`, never\n   root-absolute, so the pages work exported to a Pages subfolder.\n\n   Two pages carry a <base>: a Site preview (`preview_base`,\n   app.public_site.Page.render_preview), which also shows its banner, and\n   404.html (`site_base`, app.public_site.not_found), which GitHub Pages\n   serves at whatever path was missed. Without a site_base, 404.html inlines\n   its stylesheet (`inline_css`) instead of linking it. #}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import index_number with context %}\n{%- set base_href = preview_base or site_base -%}\n<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\">\n<head>\n  <meta charset=\"utf-8\">\n  <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n  {%- if base_href %}\n  <base href=\"{{ base_href }}\">{% endif %}\n  <title>{% if page_title %}{{ page_title }} · {% endif %}{{ title }}</title>\n  {%- if inline_css %}\n  <style>{{ inline_css }}</style>\n  {%- else %}\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"{{ root }}style.css\">\n  {%- endif %}\n</head>\n<body>\n  {#- Under a <base>, \"#main\" resolves against it, not this page. 404.html's\n      <base> is the site's root, so it skips to 404.html#main, the same page\n      at its own path. A Site preview, in a sandboxed frame in the console,\n      has none. #}\n  {%- if not preview_base %}\n  <a class=\"skip-link\" href=\"{{ '404.html' if site_base }}#main\">Skip to content</a>\n  {%- endif %}\n  <div class=\"field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n    {%- if preview_base %}\n    <p class=\"site-preview-banner\" role=\"note\">Draft preview, not published</p>{% endif %}\n    <header class=\"header-site\">\n      <a class=\"header-home\" href=\"{{ home_path }}\"><span class=\"header-mark\" aria-hidden=\"true\">IR</span><b class=\"header-home-text\">{{ title }}</b></a>\n    </header>\n    <nav class=\"nav-site\" aria-label=\"Site\"><ul>\n      {%- for report in nav_reports %}{% set path = report_path(report.slug) %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}{{ path }}\"{% if path == page_path %} aria-current=\"page\"{% endif %}>{{ index_number(loop.index) }}{{ report.title }}</a></li>\n      {%- endfor %}\n      <li><a href=\"{{ root }}data-bites/index.html\"\n        {%- if page_path == \"data-bites/index.html\" %} aria-current=\"page\"\n        {%- elif page_path.startswith(\"data-bites/\") %} aria-current=\"true\"{% endif %}>{{ index_number(nav_reports | length + 1) }}Data Bites</a></li>\n    </ul></nav>\n  </div></div>\n  <main id=\"main\">\n    {%- block field %}{% endblock %}\n    <div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n      {%- block content %}{% endblock %}\n    </div>\n  </main>\n  <footer class=\"footer-site field-site\"><div class=\"layout-wrap\">\n    <div><b>{{ title }}</b><p>The college's official source for enrollment, outcomes and survey data. Each figure is final as of the date shown with it.</p></div>\n    <div><span class=\"text-label\">Data requests</span><p><a href=\"mailto:ir@example.edu\">ir@example.edu</a></p></div>\n    <div><span class=\"text-label\">Location</span><p>Kenyon College<br>Gambier, Ohio</p></div>\n    {#- The fonts' OFL licences travel with them (ADR-007). #}\n    <p class=\"footer-colophon text-label\">Set in Atkinson Hyperlegible <a href=\"{{ root }}fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-next.txt\">Next</a> and <a href=\"{{ root }}fonts/OFL-atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.txt\">Mono</a>, under the SIL Open Font License</p>\n  </div></footer>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== templates/public/not_found.html\n{% extends \"public/layout.html\" %}\n{% from \"public/_lists.html\" import title_field, fact with context %}\n{% block field %}\n  {%- call title_field([(home_path, \"Home\")], \"Page not found\") %}\n    {%- call fact(\"Status\") %}<span class=\"text-mono\">404</span>{% endcall %}\n  {%- endcall %}\n{%- endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n      <div class=\"body-item\">\n        <p>Nothing is published at this address. name=\"item_base\" value=\"{{ form.item_base }}\">\n    {%- endif %}\n    <div class=\"admin-content-fields\">\n    <p><label>Title <input type=\"text\" name=\"title\" value=\"{{ form.title }}\" required></label></p>\n    <p><label>Slug <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ form.slug }}\" required\n      pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\" aria-describedby=\"slug-hint\"></label>\n      <small id=\"slug-hint\">Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.</small></p>\n    {#- The Editor (app.editor, static/editor.js) takes over the textarea, and\n        shows the body from the template below, which a browser never renders\n        itself. If its script doesn't run, the textarea posts Markdown, each\n        part the Editor can't edit standing as its locked-<n> line. An edit\n        page lists the item's chart images for \"Insert image\"; a create page\n        has no item to hold any yet, and lists none. #}\n    <div class=\"admin-editor\" data-body-dirty=\"{{ 1 if form.body_dirty else 0 }}\"\n      data-site-items='{{ site_items | tojson }}' data-link-states='{{ link_states | tojson }}'\n      {%- if body_images is defined %} data-images='{{ body_images | tojson }}'{% endif %}\n      data-chart-preview=\"{{ path_for('preview_chart') }}\">\n    <p><label>Body (Markdown)<br><textarea name=\"body\" rows=\"16\" cols=\"60\" required>{{ form.body }}</textarea></label></p>\n    <template class=\"admin-editor-content\">{{ editor_html }}</template>\n    </div>\n    {% if file_label %}\n    <p><label>{{ file_label }}\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"file\" accept=\"application/pdf,.pdf\"></label></p>\n    {% endif %}\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">{{ submit }}</button></p>\n    </div>\n    {#- After the save button, so Enter in a field still saves: the form's\n        first submit button is the one Enter presses. #}\n    {% include \"admin/_site_preview.html\" %}\n  </form>\n  <script src=\"{{ path_for('editor_script') }}\" defer></script>\n=== templates/admin/_site_preview.html\n{# The Site preview (T12): the item as its public page, in a frame. Needs\n   `site_preview`, that page's HTML. With `preview_path` and inside the item's\n   form, the frame follows the title and body as they are typed, and \"Preview\n   on site\" posts the unsaved form there in a new tab. Without, it shows the\n   item as saved. #}\n  <section class=\"admin-site-preview\" aria-labelledby=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">\n    <h2 id=\"admin-site-preview-heading\">Site preview</h2>\n    <p class=\"admin-site-preview-controls\">\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"desktop\" aria-pressed=\"true\">Desktop</button>\n      <button type=\"button\" data-width=\"phone\" aria-pressed=\"false\">Phone</button>\n      {%- if preview_path %}\n      <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ preview_path }}\" formtarget=\"_blank\" formnovalidate>Preview on site</button>\n      {%- endif %}\n      <small class=\"admin-site-preview-status\" role=\"status\"></small></p>\n    {#- Sandboxed: no script runs in it. Same-origin, so the page can keep its\n        scroll position across updates. #}\n    <iframe class=\"admin-site-preview-frame\" title=\"Site preview\" sandbox=\"allow-same-origin allow-downloads\" srcdoc=\"{{ site_preview }}\"></iframe>\n  </section>\n  <script>\n    (() => {\n      const section = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;\n      const frame = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-frame\");\n      const widths = section.querySelectorAll(\"[data-width]\");\n      for (const button of widths) {\n        button.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n          frame.dataset.width = button.dataset.width;\n          for (const other of widths) other.setAttribute(\"aria-pressed\", other === button);\n        });\n      }\n\n      // Re-render the preview on the server as the form is typed, so it goes\n      // through the same templates and sanitizer as the published page.\n      const form = section.closest(\"form\");\n      const path = {{ preview_path | default(none) | tojson }};\n      if (!form || !path) return;\n      const status = section.querySelector(\".admin-site-preview-status\");\n      let timer, latest = 0;\n      form.addEventListener(\"input\", (event) => {\n        // The title, the body's textarea, or the Editor (static/editor.js).\n        if (![\"title\", \"body\"].includes(event.target.name)\n            && !event.target.closest(\".admin-editor-area\")) return;\n        clearTimeout(timer);\n        timer = setTimeout(async () => {\n          const request = ++latest;\n          const data = new FormData();\n          for (const name of [\"csrf_token\", \"title\", \"body\", \"body_html\", \"body_dirty\"]) {\n            const field = form.elements[name];\n            if (field && !field.disabled) data.append(name, field.value);\n          }\n          let html = null;\n          try {\n            const response = await fetch(path, {method: \"POST\", body: data});\n            // A redirect means the session ended; don't show the login page here.\n            if (response.ok && !response.redirected) html = await response.text();\n          } catch {}\n          if (request !== latest) return;\n          if (html === null) {\n            status.textContent = \"Preview is not updating. Reload the page (you may need to log in again).\";\n            return;\n          }\n          // A new srcdoc reloads the frame at the top; keep the reader's place.\n          const y = frame.contentWindow ? frame.contentWindow.scrollY : 0;\n          frame.addEventListener(\"load\", () => frame.contentWindow.scrollTo(0, y), {once: true});\n          frame.srcdoc = html;\n          status.textContent = \"\";\n        }, 250);\n      });\n    })();\n  </script>\n=== templates/admin/data_bite_edit.html\n{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('list_bites') }}\">All Data Bites</a></p>\n  <h1>Edit Data Bite</h1>\n  <p>{{ status_labels[bite.status] }}.
