collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import chart_images, data_bites, editor, public_site\nfrom app.flash import SITE_NOTE, confirm\nfrom app.auth import current_user, require_csrf, require_director\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS, ContentError\nfrom app.rendering import images_without_description\nfrom app.routes import editing\nfrom app.routes.site_preview import site_file\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/data-bites\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n_MAX_IMAGE_MB = chart_images.MAX_BYTES // chart_images.MIB\n\n\ndef _site_preview(request: Request, form: Mapping[str, str], bite: sqlite3.Row | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to `bite` (None for a new Data\n    Bite), as HTML, served from the preview's copy of the site.\"\"\"\n    at = (request.app.url_path_for(\"bite_preview_site\", bite_id=bite[\"id\"], path=\"\")\n          if bite is not None else request.app.url_path_for(\"new_bite_preview_site\", path=\"\"))\n    return public_site.data_bite_preview(form, bite).render_preview(str(at))\n\n\ndef _images(request: Request, bite_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    return editing.image_links(request, \"serve_image\", bite_id=bite_id)\n\n\ndef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"\", \"body\": \"\"}\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], \"\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/data_bites.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Data Bites\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"bites\": data_bites.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, None),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_new_bite\")},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_bites(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _list_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_bite(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                slug: str = Form(\"\"), posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    try:\n        data_bites.create(title, slug, editor.saved_body(posted, None, None), user[\"id\"])\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _list_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, \"\", None, None))\n    confirm(request, \"Data Bite created as a Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/data-bites\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A new Data Bite's Site preview. Before the /{bite_id} routes, which would\n# otherwise take \"preview\" for an id.\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_bite(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                     posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, {\"title\": title, \"body\": shown}, None))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_bite_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Data Bite has no chart images (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\n\n\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, bite: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(bite)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"])\n    links, names = _images(request, bite[\"id\"]), list(data_bites.images(bite[\"id\"]))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/data_bite_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Data Bite\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"bite\": bite, \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], bite[\"body\"], links.src),\n         \"images\": names,\n         \"body_images\": editing.body_images(links, names),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, bite),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_bite\", bite_id=bite[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _get_or_404(bite_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    bite = data_bites.get(bite_id)\n    if bite is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return bite\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}\")\ndef edit_bite_form(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(bite_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_bite(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n              title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n              posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted), item_base: str = Form(\"\")):\n    bite = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n    image_name = _images(request, bite_id).name\n    try:\n        data_bites.update(bite_id, title, slug,\n                          editor.saved_edit(posted, bite, item_base, image_name),\n                          base=item_base or None)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        # Shown over the item as stored now, which a stale form missed.\n        current = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n        return _edit_page(request, user, current, error=str(exc),\n                          status_code=editing.refused_status(exc),\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, item_base,\n                                                 current[\"body\"], image_name))\n    confirm(request, \"Data Bite saved.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_bite(request: Request, bite_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                 posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The edit form's Site preview, of its unsaved title and body, for its\n    frame and \"Preview on site\". Saves nothing.\"\"\"\n    bite = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, bite[\"body\"],\n                      _images(request, bite_id).name)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, {\"title\": title, \"body\": shown}, bite))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef bite_preview_site(bite_id: int, path: str):\n    \"\"\"The Site preview's copy of the site: its stylesheet and the Data\n    Bite's chart images, draft or not (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images=public_site.data_bite_files(_get_or_404(bite_id)))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}/images/{name}\")\ndef serve_image(bite_id: int, name: str):\n    path = data_bites.images(bite_id).get(name)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return chart_images.response(path)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/images\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef upload_image(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    bite = _get_or_404(bite_id)\n    try:\n        if not data_bites.add_image(bite_id, chart_images.read(file)):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _edit_page(request, user, bite, error=str(exc), status_code=400)\n    confirm(request, \"Chart image uploaded.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/images/{name}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef delete_image(request: Request, bite_id: int, name: str):\n    if not data_bites.remove_image(bite_id, name):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"Chart image deleted.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\ndef _set_status(request: Request, bite_id: int, status: str, message: str):\n    if not data_bites.set_status(bite_id, status):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, message + SITE_NOTE)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/data-bites\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/publish\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef publish(request: Request, bite_id: int):\n    return _set_status(request, bite_id, \"published\", \"Data Bite published.\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef unpublish(request: Request, bite_id: int):\n    return _set_status(request, bite_id, \"draft\", \"Data Bite moved back to Draft.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{bite_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_director)])\ndef confirm_delete_bite(request: Request, bite_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return editing.confirm_delete(request, user, _get_or_404(bite_id), \"data-bite\",\n                                  back=request.app.url_path_for(\"list_bites\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{bite_id}/delete\",\n             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef delete(request: Request, bite_id: int):\n    if not data_bites.delete(bite_id):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"Data Bite deleted.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/data-bites\", status_code=303)\n\"\"\"What the Data Bite and Report routes share about a body posted from their\nedit and create forms, with or without the Editor (app.editor).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Form, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import editor, site_links\nfrom app.content import ContentError, StaleItem\nfrom app.markdown_form import ImageName\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\ndef posted(body: str = Form(\"\"), body_html: str | None = Form(None),\n           body_dirty: str = Form(\"0\")) -> editor.Posted:\n    \"\"\"The form's body fields, as a route dependency: `body_html` and\n    `body_dirty` only if the Editor's script ran; `body` is the textarea's\n    Markdown.\"\"\"\n    return editor.Posted(body=body, body_html=body_html, body_dirty=body_dirty == \"1\")\n\n\ndef image_links(request: Request, route: str, **item_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    \"\"\"How the Editor shows an item's chart images: from `route`, the admin\n    route that serves them, draft or not.\"\"\"\n    image = str(request.app.url_path_for(route, name=\"x\", **item_id))\n    return editor.image_links(image.removesuffix(\"x\"))\n\n\ndef body_images(links: editor.ImageLinks, names) -> list[dict]:\n    \"\"\"The item's chart images, for the Editor's \"Insert image\" to list:\n    each one's name, and the admin src it is shown from.\"\"\"\n    return [{\"name\": name, \"src\": links.src(name)} for name in names]\n\n\ndef refused_status(exc: ContentError) -> int:\n    \"\"\"A refused save's status: 409 if the item changed since its form was\n    opened, else 400.\"\"\"\n    return 409 if isinstance(exc, StaleItem) else 400\n\n\ndef previewed(body: editor.Posted, stored: str | None, image_name: ImageName | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The body a Site preview shows for a post: what saving it would save.\n    400 if it can't be saved.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        return editor.saved_body(body, stored, image_name)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(exc)) from None\n\n\ndef site_links_for(body: str) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"What the Editor's link dialog and markers need, for a form whose full\n    body is `body`: every item it may link to, and the state of each site\n    link in the body that won't be a link on the site.\"\"\"\n    return {\"site_items\": site_links.choices(), \"link_states\": site_links.unresolved(body)}\n\n\ndef confirm_delete(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, item: sqlite3.Row, kind: str, *,\n                   back: str):\n    \"\"\"The page before a delete (Director only), which posts to its own\n    path: the items whose bodies link to `item`, a `kind` of item, and whose\n    links will be their text once it is gone. The delete isn't blocked.\"\"\"\n    noun = site_links.NOUNS[kind]\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"Delete {noun}\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user, \"noun\": noun,\n         \"item\": item, \"action\": request.url.path, \"back\": back,\n         \"linked_from\": site_links.linked_from(site_links.reference(kind, item[\"ref\"]))})\n\"\"\"The admin console. Every route on this router requires an active session:\nadd new admin routes here (or to a router built the same way) and they are\nprotected without further work.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom types import ModuleType\nfrom typing import Literal\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Query, Request\nfrom fastapi.exception_handlers import http_exception_handler\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\n\nfrom app import data_bites, reports, settings\nfrom app.auth import current_user\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n\n\nasync def refused_page(request: Request, exc: StarletteHTTPException):\n    \"\"\"A 403 (e.g. an Analyst on a Director-only page) as a page with a way\n    back, not FastAPI's JSON. Any other HTTP error is handled as FastAPI would.\"\"\"\n    if exc.status_code != 403:\n        return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/forbidden.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"home_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"admin_home\"),\n         \"reason\": exc.detail},\n        status_code=403,\n    )\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentType:\n    key: str        # e.g. \"data-bite\", as used in ids and query strings\n    noun: str       # e.g. \"Data Bite\"\n    plural: str     # e.g. \"Data Bites\"\n    module: ModuleType\n    list_path: str  # the type's own admin page, e.g. \"/admin/data-bites\"\n\n\nCONTENT_TYPES = (\n    ContentType(\"data-bite\", \"Data Bite\", \"Data Bites\", data_bites, \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n    ContentType(\"report\", \"Report\", \"Reports\", reports, \"/admin/reports\"),\n)\n# The content list's filters; \"\" (the form's \"All\") means no filter.\nTypeFilter = Literal[\"\", *(ctype.key for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES)]\nStatusFilter = Literal[\"\", *STATUS_LABELS]\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    counts = {ctype.key: ctype.module.count_by_status() for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES}\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/home.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/content\")\ndef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Data Bites and Reports together, most recently updated first,\n    optionally narrowed to one type and/or one status.\"\"\"\n    items = [(ctype, item) for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES if content_type in (\"\", ctype.key)\n             for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)]\n    items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[1][\"updated_at\"], reverse=True)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/content.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"items\": items, \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"chosen\": {\"type\": content_type, \"status\": status}},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/editor.js\")\ndef editor_script():\n    \"\"\"The Editor's script (app.editor), for the edit and create pages only.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(settings.STATIC / \"editor.js\", media_type=\"text/javascript\")\n\"\"\"User management: Director only. Analysts get 403 on every route here.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import users\nfrom app.auth import require_csrf, require_director\nfrom app.flash import confirm\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/users\", dependencies=[Depends(require_director)])\n\n\ndef _users_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n                form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/users.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Users\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"users\": users.list_users(), \"role_labels\": users.ROLE_LABELS,\n         \"min_password_length\": users.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form or {}},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_users(request: Request, user=Depends(require_director)):\n    return _users_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_user(request: Request, user=Depends(require_director),\n                email: str = Form(\"\"), name: str = Form(\"\"),\n                password: str = Form(\"\"), role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    try:\n        users.create_user(email, password, role, name=name)\n    except users.UserError as exc:\n        # Re-fill everything but the password.\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n                           form={\"email\": email, \"name\": name, \"role\": role})\n    confirm(request, \"User created.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A Director may not demote or deactivate themselves: the acting Director always\n# stays an active Director, so the office can never lose its last one.\nSELF_LOCKOUT = \"You can't change the role of, or deactivate, your own account.\"\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/role\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef change_role(request: Request, user_id: int, user=Depends(require_director),\n                role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    if user_id == user[\"id\"]:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=SELF_LOCKOUT, status_code=400)\n    try:\n        found = users.set_role(user_id, role)\n    except users.UserError as exc:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)\n    if not found:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"Role changed.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef deactivate(request: Request, user_id: int, user=Depends(require_director)):\n    if user_id == user[\"id\"]:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=SELF_LOCKOUT, status_code=400)\n    if not users.deactivate(user_id):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"User deactivated.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\nitsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\nre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\naccount ends its sessions at once.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.clear()\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    if not users.is_director(user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if token is None:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"21ab0e6d-2433-4ead-9dc9-1c133a32c784","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:19:09.084Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Data Bites in the admin console. Any other HTTP error is handled as FastAPI would.\"\"\"\n    if exc.status_code != 403:\n        return await http_exception_handler(request, exc)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/forbidden.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Not allowed\", \"home_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"admin_home\"),\n         \"reason\": exc.detail},\n        status_code=403,\n    )\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ContentType:\n    key: str        # e.g. \"data-bite\", as used in ids and query strings\n    noun: str       # e.g. \"Data Bite\"\n    plural: str     # e.g. \"Data Bites\"\n    module: ModuleType\n    list_path: str  # the type's own admin page, e.g. \"/admin/data-bites\"\n\n\nCONTENT_TYPES = (\n    ContentType(\"data-bite\", \"Data Bite\", \"Data Bites\", data_bites, \"/admin/data-bites\"),\n    ContentType(\"report\", \"Report\", \"Reports\", reports, \"/admin/reports\"),\n)\n# The content list's filters; \"\" (the form's \"All\") means no filter.\nTypeFilter = Literal[\"\", *(ctype.key for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES)]\nStatusFilter = Literal[\"\", *STATUS_LABELS]\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef admin_home(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    counts = {ctype.key: ctype.module.count_by_status() for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES}\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/home.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/content\")\ndef content_list(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user),\n                 content_type: TypeFilter = Query(\"\", alias=\"type\"),\n                 status: StatusFilter = \"\"):\n    \"\"\"Data Bites and Reports together, most recently updated first,\n    optionally narrowed to one type and/or one status.\"\"\"\n    items = [(ctype, item) for ctype in CONTENT_TYPES if content_type in (\"\", ctype.key)\n             for item in ctype.module.list_all(status or None)]\n    items.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[1][\"updated_at\"], reverse=True)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/content.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"All content\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"items\": items, \"content_types\": CONTENT_TYPES,\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"chosen\": {\"type\": content_type, \"status\": status}},\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"/editor.js\")\ndef editor_script():\n    \"\"\"The Editor's script (app.editor), for the edit and create pages only.\"\"\"\n    return FileResponse(settings.STATIC / \"editor.js\", media_type=\"text/javascript\")\n\"\"\"User management: Director only. Analysts get 403 on every route here.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import users\nfrom app.auth import require_csrf, require_director\nfrom app.flash import confirm\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/users\", dependencies=[Depends(require_director)])\n\n\ndef _users_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n                form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/users.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Users\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"users\": users.list_users(), \"role_labels\": users.ROLE_LABELS,\n         \"min_password_length\": users.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form or {}},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_users(request: Request, user=Depends(require_director)):\n    return _users_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_user(request: Request, user=Depends(require_director),\n                email: str = Form(\"\"), name: str = Form(\"\"),\n                password: str = Form(\"\"), role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    try:\n        users.create_user(email, password, role, name=name)\n    except users.UserError as exc:\n        # Re-fill everything but the password.\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n                           form={\"email\": email, \"name\": name, \"role\": role})\n    confirm(request, \"User created.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A Director may not demote or deactivate themselves: the acting Director always\n# stays an active Director, so the office can never lose its last one.\nSELF_LOCKOUT = \"You can't change the role of, or deactivate, your own account.\"\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/role\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef change_role(request: Request, user_id: int, user=Depends(require_director),\n                role: str = Form(\"\")):\n    if user_id == user[\"id\"]:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=SELF_LOCKOUT, status_code=400)\n    try:\n        found = users.set_role(user_id, role)\n    except users.UserError as exc:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400)\n    if not found:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"Role changed.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{user_id}/deactivate\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef deactivate(request: Request, user_id: int, user=Depends(require_director)):\n    if user_id == user[\"id\"]:\n        return _users_page(request, user, error=SELF_LOCKOUT, status_code=400)\n    if not users.deactivate(user_id):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"User deactivated.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/users\", status_code=303)\n\"\"\"Sessions and CSRF.\n\nThe session is a signed cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, which signs with\nitsdangerous). It holds only the user's id and a CSRF token. The user is\nre-loaded from the database on every protected request, so deactivating an\naccount ends its sessions at once.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import users\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised by current_user; main.py turns it into a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef current_user(request: Request) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: the logged-in, still-active user, or LoginRequired.\"\"\"\n    user_id = request.session.get(\"user_id\")\n    user = users.get_active_user(user_id) if user_id is not None else None\n    if user is None:\n        request.session.clear()\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef require_director(user: sqlite3.Row = Depends(current_user)) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"Dependency: current_user, but 403 unless they are a Director.\"\"\"\n    if not users.is_director(user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Directors only.\")\n    return user\n\n\ndef log_in(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    # A fresh session (and CSRF token) on login, so a pre-login cookie planted\n    # by someone else never becomes an authenticated one.\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"user_id\"] = user[\"id\"]\n    csrf_token(request)\n\n\ndef log_out(request: Request) -> None:\n    request.session.clear()\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The session's CSRF token, created on first use. Templates call this.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if token is None:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf_token\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nasync def require_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every state-changing POST: the form's csrf_token must\n    match the session's.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    submitted = form.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not (isinstance(submitted, str) and expected\n            and secrets.compare_digest(submitted, expected)):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=\"Invalid or missing CSRF token.\")","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"3520a6b2-bebb-406b-8aef-721cec06ce38","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"3f2eac99-ed68-46af-b07a-342530f94056","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"d171bff4-3fe7-48c5-ad0f-bea8dc3ca405","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"63823680-50d9-4a07-aebf-dc341064a9d7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HtBAVhH2xkbZrPrGQGVkUh","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Reports in the admin console. Any signed-in user may list Reports, create a\ndraft, edit a draft (its body, its attached file, or its chart images, and\nthe Site preview of its edits), and download a Report's file or view its\nimages or its saved Site preview. Editing a published Report, its file, or its\nimages, and publishing, unpublishing, or deleting any Report, is Director\nonly.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import chart_images, editor, public_site, reports, uploads\nfrom app.flash import SITE_NOTE, confirm\nfrom app.auth import current_user, require_csrf, require_director\nfrom app.content import STATUS_LABELS, ContentError\nfrom app.rendering import images_without_description\nfrom app.routes import editing\nfrom app.routes.site_preview import site_file\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/reports\", dependencies=[Depends(current_user)])\n_MAX_FILE_MB = uploads.MAX_BYTES // uploads.MIB\n_MAX_IMAGE_MB = chart_images.MAX_BYTES // chart_images.MIB\n\n\ndef _site_preview(request: Request, form: Mapping[str, str], report: sqlite3.Row | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The Site preview of `form`'s edits to `report` (None for a new\n    Report), as HTML, served from the preview's copy of the site.\"\"\"\n    at = (request.app.url_path_for(\"report_preview_site\", report_id=report[\"id\"], path=\"\")\n          if report is not None else request.app.url_path_for(\"new_report_preview_site\", path=\"\"))\n    return public_site.report_preview(form, report).render_preview(str(at))\n\n\ndef _images(request: Request, report_id: int) -> editor.ImageLinks:\n    return editing.image_links(request, \"serve_image\", report_id=report_id)\n\n\ndef _list_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, *, error: str | None = None,\n               form: dict | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or {\"title\": \"\", \"slug\": \"\", \"body\": \"\"}\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], \"\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/reports.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Reports\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"reports\": reports.list_all(), \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS,\n         \"error\": error, \"form\": form, \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], \"\", None),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, None),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_new_report\")},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\n@router.get(\"\")\ndef list_reports(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _list_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef create_report(request: Request, user=Depends(current_user), title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                  slug: str = Form(\"\"), posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                  file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        reports.create(title, slug, editor.saved_body(posted, None, None), user[\"id\"], pdf=pdf)\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        return _list_page(request, user, error=str(exc), status_code=400,\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, \"\", None, None))\n    confirm(request, \"Report created as a Draft, with its attached file.\" if pdf\n            else \"Report created as a Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n\n\n# A new Report's Site preview. Before the /{report_id} routes, which would\n# otherwise take \"preview\" for an id.\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_new_report(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"),\n                       posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview, for its frame and \"Preview on site\".\n    Saves nothing; a file chosen in the form is not read.\"\"\"\n    shown = editing.previewed(posted, None, None)\n    return HTMLResponse(_site_preview(request, {\"title\": title, \"body\": shown}, None))\n\n\n@router.get(\"/preview/{path:path}\")\ndef new_report_preview_site(path: str):\n    \"\"\"The create form's Site preview's copy of the site: only its stylesheet,\n    as a new Report has no chart images or file (app.routes.site_preview).\"\"\"\n    return site_file(path, images={})\n\n\ndef _edit_page(request: Request, user: sqlite3.Row, report: sqlite3.Row, *,\n               error: str | None = None, form: dict | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    form = form or editor.form_for(report)\n    # The body with its locked blocks, which only the server sees.\n    body = editor.full_body(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"])\n    links, names = _images(request, report[\"id\"]), list(reports.images(report[\"id\"]))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/report_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Edit Report\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"user\": user,\n         \"report\": report, \"can_edit\": reports.can_edit(report, user),\n         \"status_labels\": STATUS_LABELS, \"error\": error, \"form\": form,\n         \"max_file_mb\": _MAX_FILE_MB,\n         \"editor_html\": editor.editor_html(form[\"body\"], report[\"body\"], links.src),\n         \"images\": names,\n         \"body_images\": editing.body_images(links, names),\n         **editing.site_links_for(body),\n         \"site_preview\": _site_preview(request, {**form, \"body\": body}, report),\n         \"preview_path\": request.app.url_path_for(\"preview_report\", report_id=report[\"id\"]),\n         \"undescribed_images\": images_without_description(body),\n         \"max_image_mb\": _MAX_IMAGE_MB,\n         \"max_images\": chart_images.MAX_PER_ITEM},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n\n\ndef _get_or_404(report_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    report = reports.get(report_id)\n    if report is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return report\n\n\ndef _editable_or_403(report_id: int, user: sqlite3.Row) -> sqlite3.Row:\n    \"\"\"The Report, if `user` may change it. Checked before anything sent is\n    looked at, so a locked Report is 403 whatever was sent. The write checks\n    again, in its UPDATE, in case the Report is published in between; that\n    raises ReportLocked, which the routes also turn into a 403.\"\"\"\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    if not reports.can_edit(report, user):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=reports.LOCKED)\n    return report\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}\")\ndef edit_report_form(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return _edit_page(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef edit_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                title: str = Form(\"\"), slug: str = Form(\"\"),\n                posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted),\n                item_base: str = Form(\"\"), file: UploadFile | None = File(None)):\n    report = _editable_or_403(report_id, user)\n    image_name = _images(request, report_id).name\n    try:\n        pdf = uploads.read_pdf(file)\n        if not reports.update(report_id, title, slug,\n                              editor.saved_edit(posted, report, item_base, image_name),\n                              user=user, pdf=pdf, base=item_base or None):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    except ContentError as exc:\n        # Shown over the Report as stored now, which a stale form missed.\n        current = _get_or_404(report_id)\n        return _edit_page(request, user, current, error=str(exc),\n                          status_code=editing.refused_status(exc),\n                          form=editor.form_after(posted, title, slug, item_base,\n                                                 current[\"body\"], image_name))\n    confirm(request, \"Report saved, with its new attached file.\" if pdf\n            else \"Report saved.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/file\")\ndef download_file(report_id: int):\n    report = _get_or_404(report_id)\n    path = reports.file_path(report_id)\n    if report[\"file_name\"] is None or not path.is_file():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return FileResponse(path, media_type=\"application/pdf\",\n                        filename=report[\"file_name\"],\n                        headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/file/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef remove_file(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    try:\n        if not reports.remove_file(report_id, user=user):\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    except reports.ReportLocked as exc:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail=str(exc)) from None\n    confirm(request, \"Attached file removed.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(f\"/admin/reports/{report_id}\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/preview\", dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef preview_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user),\n                   title: str = Form(\"\"), posted: editor.Posted = Depends(editing.posted)):\n    \"\"\"The edit form's Site preview, of its unsaved title and body, for its\n    frame and \"Preview on site\". Only for a user who may make those edits\n    (the lockdown). dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef unpublish(request: Request, report_id: int):\n    return _set_status(request, report_id, \"draft\", \"Report moved back to Draft.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{report_id}/delete\", dependencies=[Depends(require_director)])\ndef confirm_delete_report(request: Request, report_id: int, user=Depends(current_user)):\n    return editing.confirm_delete(request, user, _get_or_404(report_id), \"report\",\n                                  back=request.app.url_path_for(\"list_reports\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{report_id}/delete\",\n             dependencies=[Depends(require_director), Depends(require_csrf)])\ndef delete(request: Request, report_id: int):\n    if not reports.delete(report_id):\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    confirm(request, \"Report deleted.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/reports\", status_code=303)\n\"\"\"Confirmations: a one-line success message that survives the redirect after a\nstate-changing admin action.\n\nA route calls confirm() after the action succeeds and before it redirects. The\nmessage waits in the session (a signed cookie, so it must never hold anything\nsensitive: pass fixed text, not titles, emails, or filenames) until the next\nadmin page renders it, once, through the confirmation() template global.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\n_KEY = \"confirmation\"\n\n# Publishing changes a row's status, not the exported site; say so.\nSITE_NOTE = \" The public site updates at the next cms publish.\"\n\n\ndef confirm(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    request.session[_KEY] = message\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef confirmation(context) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The waiting message, removed so it shows once. Admin pages only: the\n    base template calls this only when a signed-in user is in the context.\"\"\"\n    return context[\"request\"].session.pop(_KEY, None)\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nThe admin console lives under /admin (login required) and the public site\nat /. Routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nfrom contextlib import asynccontextmanager\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\nfrom starlette.exceptions import HTTPException as StarletteHTTPException\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import db, settings\nfrom app.auth import LoginRequired, current_user\nfrom app.routes import admin, auth, charts, data_bites, public, reports, users\n\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 8 * 60 * 60  # one working day\nALL_METHODS = [\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"POST\", \"PUT\", \"PATCH\", \"DELETE\", \"OPTIONS\"]\n\n\n@asynccontextmanager\nasync def lifespan(app: FastAPI):\n    # At server start, not import, so importing app.main never touches a database.\n    db.init_db()\n    if settings.SECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER:\n        print(\"WARNING: CMS_SECRET_KEY is unset or the .env.example placeholder; \"\n              \"session cookies can be forged. Set a long random value in .env.\",\n              file=sys.stderr)\n    yield\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\", lifespan=lifespan)\n    app.add_middleware(\n        SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n        session_cookie=\"cms_session\", max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\",\n    )\n\n    app.add_exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException, admin.refused_page)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(LoginRequired)\n    def redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: LoginRequired):\n        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n    app.include_router(public.router)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(admin.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    app.include_router(data_bites.router)\n    app.include_router(reports.router)\n    app.include_router(charts.router)\n\n    # Must stay last: any /admin request no router above claimed, by path or by\n    # method. Anonymous visitors are sent to login (so they can't probe which\n    # admin paths exist); signed-in users get 405/404.\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_method_not_allowed():\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=405)\n\n    @app.api_route(\"/admin/{rest:path}\", methods=ALL_METHODS,\n                   dependencies=[Depends(current_user)], include_in_schema=False)\n    def admin_not_found(rest: str):\n        if rest == \"\":\n            return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=307)\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"The Jinja environment the admin console and the public site render with.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\nfrom jinja2 import pass_context\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.auth import csrf_token\nfrom app.flash import confirmation\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\nfrom app.users import ROLE_LABELS\n\n\n\n@pass_context\ndef path_for(context, name: str, **path_params) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The path of the admin route called `name` (its function's name), e.g.\n    path_for(\"edit_report_form\", report_id=3) -> \"/admin/reports/3\", so a\n    template never hard-codes a route's path. Admin pages only: the public\n    site links relatively (app.public_site).\"\"\"\n    return str(context[\"request\"].app.url_path_for(name, **path_params))\n\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\ntemplates.env.globals[\"path_for\"] = path_for\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"confirmation\"] = confirmation\ntemplates.env.filters[\"role_label\"] = ROLE_LABELS.get\ntemplates.env.filters[\"markdown\"] = render_markdown\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n\n\ndef _load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Read KEY=VALUE lines from .env into os.environ. Variables already set in\n    the real environment win.\"\"\"\n    if not path.is_file():\n        return\n    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():\n        key, sep, value = line.partition(\"=\")\n        key = key.strip()\n        if not sep or not key or key.startswith(\"#\"):\n            continue\n        os.environ.setdefault(key, value.strip().strip(\"'\\\"\"))\n\n\n_load_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n# The console's script (served under its login) and stylesheet, and the\n# public site's stylesheet and fonts (ADR-007).\nSTATIC = ROOT / \"static\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nSECRET_KEY_IS_PLACEHOLDER = SECRET_KEY in (\n    \"dev-only-not-for-production\", \"[REDACTED]\")\n# A relative CMS_DATABASE is relative to the repo, not the current directory.\nDATABASE_PATH = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\")\n# Uploaded Report files. Outside site/, and gitignored like the database.\nUPLOADS = ROOT / os.environ.get(\"CMS_UPLOADS\", \"uploads\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"serverClassifierContext":{"request":"3520a6b2-bebb-406b-8aef-721cec06ce38","context":{"git_state":{"cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","root":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","branch":"main","default_branch":"main","status":{"clean":false,"counts":{"staged":0,"modified":1,"untracked":null,"untracked_normal":3},"porcelain":null,"truncated":false},"visibility":{"origin":{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"},"push_remote":"origin","remotes":[{"name":"origin","host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}],"visibility_cache":[{"host":"github.com","remote":"DavelleAT/iphs400-mp2-cms","visibility":"public"}]}},"live_cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","platform":"macos"}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d171bff4-3fe7-48c5-ad0f-bea8dc3ca405","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"20d4d8e8-ef5f-490d-84bd-8a0de068549c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"63823680-50d9-4a07-aebf-dc341064a9d7","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_015JpsVrJo5Zj1L5ewWDnJNP","type":"tool_result","content":"---\nname: browser-checks-environment\ndescription: \"What works for ticket browser checks here: viewport widths, phone width, real pastes, scratch instance\"\nmetadata:\n  node_type: memory\n  type: reference\n  originSessionId: 6d83085c-4859-4681-9c06-b59afa52f437\n  modified: 2026-10-01T15:44:20.809Z\n---\n\nBrowser checks for closing comments (spec #14) in this environment, as of 2026-10-01:\n\n- **768/1440 px and dark mode work through a same-origin iframe harness** (T19, 2026-10-01): serve the scratch `cms publish` export plus a harness page with `python -m http.server`, put iframes at 1440/768/390 px side by side scaled with `transform: scale()` (their `innerWidth` stays true, so media queries apply), and force dark by setting each `prefers-color-scheme: dark` CSSMediaRule's `media.mediaText = \"all\"` inside the frame. Print: same trick on `@media print`. Report `document.fonts` statuses and `scrollWidth > innerWidth` in the harness's status line.\n- **Screenshot `scale` also shrinks the saved file**: use scale 1 with `save_to_disk` for anything going in docs/screenshots.\n- **Programmatic `.focus()` in a frame doesn't match `:focus`** (no window focus); press real Tab keys on the page itself (the first Tab lands in browser chrome).\n- **Claude in Chrome's resize_window doesn't change the viewport** (stayed 516 px, or whatever the window is). 768/1440 px checks can't be done that way.\n- **gstack `browse` (headless) is killed by the command sandbox** (exit 137), and running it with the sandbox disabled was refused by the auto-mode classifier. Don't retry; ask the user.\n- **390 px for anything besides the public page** (e.g. a dialog): put a same-origin `<iframe src=\"/admin/...\">` 390 px wide on an admin page and drive it; its `innerWidth` is 390 and media queries apply. Keep it ≤740 px tall so the screenshot (scaled ~1.14×) shows it whole.\n- **Port 8001 may already be taken** by a leftover T15 scratch `cms serve` (its own scratch DB); check `lsof -ti :8001` and use another port rather than trusting it.\n- **Phone width works through the app itself**: the Site preview's **Phone** toggle frames the page at 390 px (388 inside).\n- **Real Excel/Sheets pastes need the user**: OS keystrokes via osascript stall on a permission prompt. {"parentUuid":"b40b918e-d304-4574-a815-7a24e8fcbf90","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbywMzLdruaJ7d3bmskr","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TcbxBahgsC7NHxEZYazCAJ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t20_summaries.py","content":"\"\"\"T20: Summaries (issue #24, spec #22).\n\nEvery Data Bite and Report may carry a Summary: plain text, trimmed, at most\n200 characters, escaped like the title. It shows under the item's title, in\nthe public lists, and in the page's description and link-preview tags.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app import content, data_bites, reports\nfrom app.content import ContentError, SUMMARY_MAX\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import REPORT, create_report\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t12_site_preview import preview\n\nSUMMARY = \"Headcount by class on the census date. The first-year class grew.\"\nKINDS = [(\"data-bites\", BITE, create_bite, data_bites),\n         (\"reports\", REPORT, create_report, reports)]\n\n\ndef meta(page: str, attribute: str, name: str) -> str | None:\n    found = re.findall(rf'<meta {attribute}=\"{re.escape(name)}\" content=\"([^\"]*)\">', page)\n    assert len(found) <= 1, found\n    return found[0] if found else None\n\n\n# The rule\n\ndef test_a_summary_is_trimmed_and_optional():\n    assert content.validate_summary(\"  \" + SUMMARY + \"\\n\") == SUMMARY\n    assert content.validate_summary(\"\") == \"\"\n    assert content.validate_summary(\"   \") == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_a_summary_of_200_characters_is_kept_and_201_refused():\n    assert SUMMARY_MAX == 200\n    assert content.validate_summary(\"é\" * 200) == \"é\" * 200  # characters, not bytes\n    with pytest.raises(ContentError) as refused:\n        content.validate_summary(\"x\" * 201)\n    assert refused.value.field == \"summary\"\n    assert \"200\" in str(refused.value)\n\n\ndef test_a_summary_is_one_paragraph_of_plain_text():\n    # A line break is kept as a space: it's one or two sentences, not Markdown.\n    assert content.validate_summary(\"One line.\\r\\nTwo lines.\") == \"One line. Two lines.\"\n\n\n# The edit forms\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_summary_is_saved_from_the_create_and_edit_forms(client_as, kind, item, create, module):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, summary=\"  First version.  \")\n    assert module.get(int(item_id))[\"summary\"] == \"First version.\"\n\n    form = director.get(f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<textarea[^>]*name=\"summary\"[^>]*>First version\\.</textarea>', form)\n    assert 'data-summary-max=\"200\"' in form\n\n    response = post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", {**item, \"summary\": SUMMARY})\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert module.get(int(item_id))[\"summary\"] == SUMMARY\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"kind, item, create, module\", KINDS)\ndef test_a_long_summary_is_refused_by_the_field_and_kept_in_it(client_as, kind, item, create, module):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    item_id = create(director, summary=\"Kept.\")\n    too_long = \"y\" * 201\n\n    response = post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}/{item_id}\", {**item, \"summary\": too_long})\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert module.get(int(item_id))[\"summary\"] == \"Kept.\"\n    # The message sits by the field, which keeps what was typed.\n    assert re.search(r'id=\"summary-error\"[^>]*>[^<]*200 characters', response.text)\n    assert re.search(r'name=\"summary\"[^>]*aria-describedby=\"[^\"]*summary-error', response.text)\n    assert f\">{too_long}</textarea>\" in response.text\n\n    response = post_form(director, f\"/admin/{kind}\", {**item, \"slug\": \"other\", \"summary\": too_long})\n    assert response.status_code == 400 and 'id=\"summary-error\"' in response.text\n\n\ndef test_an_item_saved_from_an_older_form_with_another_summary_is_stale(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    bite = create_bite(director, summary=\"Old.\")\n    base = re.search(r'name=\"item_base\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"',\n                     director.get(f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}\").text).group(1)\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}\",\n                     {**BITE, \"summary\": \"New.\", \"item_base\": base}).status_code == 303\n    stale = post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}\",\n                      {**BITE, \"summary\": \"Older tab.\", \"item_base\": base})\n    assert stale.status_code == 409\n    assert data_bites.get(int(bite))[\"summary\"] == \"New.\"\n\n\n# The public site\n\ndef test_the_summary_shows_under_the_title_and_in_the_lists(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    published_bite(director, summary=SUMMARY)\n    published_report(director, summary=\"Admissions and enrollment, each term.\")\n\n    for path in [\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"/data-bites/index.html\", \"/\"]:\n        assert SUMMARY in client.get(path).text, path\n    for path in [\"/reports/factbook.html\", \"/reports/index.html\", \"/\"]:\n        assert \"Admissions and enrollment, each term.\" in client.get(path).text, path\n\n    page = client.get(\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").text\n    assert page.index(BITE[\"title\"]) < page.index(f'<p class=\"summary-item\">{SUMMARY}</p>')\n\n\ndef test_an_item_without_a_summary_shows_nothing_in_its_place(client_as, client):\n    published_bite(client_as(\"editor\"))\n    page = client.get(\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").text\n    assert \"summary-item\" not in page\n    assert meta(page, \"name\", \"description\") is None\n    assert meta(page, \"property\", \"og:description\") is None\n    assert meta(page, \"property\", \"og:title\") == BITE[\"title\"]\n\n\ndef test_a_summary_is_escaped_everywhere_it_shows(client_as, client):\n    published_bite(client_as(\"editor\"), summary='<script>alert(1)</script> & \"quotes\"')\n    for path in [\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", \"/data-bites/index.html\", \"/\"]:\n        page = client.get(path).text\n        assert \"<script>alert(1)\" not in page, path\n        assert \"&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt; &amp; \" in page, path\n    page = client.get(\"/data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\").text\n    assert meta(page, \"name\", \"description\") == (\n A hash\n    of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or slug.\"\"\"\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps([title, slug, body]).encode()).hexdigest()\n''', '''# A Summary's limit, in characters (code points), which the edit form counts\n# the same way (spec #22).\nSUMMARY_MAX = 200\n\n\ndef item_base(title: str, slug: str, body: str, summary: str = \"\") -> str:\n    \"\"\"The version of an item an edit form was opened on: a hash of its\n    stored title, slug, body, and Summary, all of which the form saves. A\n    hash of the body alone would let a stale form overwrite a newer title or\n    slug. An item without a Summary hashes as it did before Summaries.\"\"\"\n    fields = [title, slug, body, summary] if summary else [title, slug, body]\n    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(fields).encode()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef validate_summary(summary: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A Summary as stored: plain text on one line, its runs of whitespace\n    (line breaks too) as single spaces, trimmed. {"parentUuid":"cdc11daa-fdc0-418d-b86a-9da349550a35","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbzS8FA6PWQu23oEL8in","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01X99mK7YMPwCZWSnNJoHNpz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t20_homepage.py","content":"\"\"\"T20: Homepage settings (issue #24, spec #22).\n\nThe Director edits the homepage's headline, its accent, its intro, and up to\nfour Key figures at /admin/homepage. They are settings, not content: no\nDraft, and they reach the site at the next `cms publish`.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import homepage\nfrom tests.conftest import post_form\n\nSETTINGS = {\"headline\": \"Kenyon, by the numbers,\", \"headline_accent\": \"checked twice.\",\n            \"intro\": \"Enrollment and outcomes from the census.\",\n            \"figure_value_1\": \"1,805\", \"figure_label_1\": \"Students enrolled\",\n            \"figure_note_1\": \"Fall 2026 census\",\n            \"figure_value_2\": \"10:1\", \"figure_label_2\": \"Student–faculty ratio\",\n            \"figure_note_2\": \"\"}\n\n\ndef saved(director, **override):\n    return post_form(director, \"/admin/homepage\", {**SETTINGS, **override})\n\n\n# Who may edit it\n\ndef test_a_fresh_site_has_the_sample_homepage():\n    settings = homepage.get()\n    assert settings.headline and settings.intro\n    assert len(settings.key_figures) == 4\n    assert all(figure.value and figure.label for figure in settings.key_figures)\n\n\ndef test_the_director_sees_the_homepage_settings_and_a_link_to_them(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/homepage\"' in director.get(\"/admin\").text\n    page = director.get(\"/admin/homepage\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert 'name=\"csrf_token\"' in page.text\n    assert f'value=\"{homepage.get().headline}\"' in page.text\n    # Four rows of Key figure fields, filled from the settings.\n    assert len(re.findall(r'name=\"figure_value_\\d\"', page.text)) == homepage.FIGURES_MAX\n\n\ndef test_an_analyst_gets_403_and_no_link(client_as):\n    analyst = client_as(\"editor\")\n    assert 'href=\"/admin/homepage\"' not in analyst.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert analyst.get(\"/admin/homepage\").status_code == 403\n    before = homepage.get()\n    assert saved(analyst).status_code == 403\n    assert homepage.get() == before\n\n\ndef test_a_save_without_its_csrf_token_is_refused(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    before = homepage.get()\n    response = post_form(director, \"/admin/homepage\", SETTINGS, with_csrf=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 403\n    assert homepage.get() == before\n\n\ndef test_signed_out_is_sent_to_login(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/admin/homepage\", follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303 and response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n# Saving\n\ndef test_the_director_saves_the_homepage(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = saved(director, headline=\"  Kenyon, by the numbers,  \")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/homepage\"\n    assert \"Homepage saved.\" in director.get(\"/admin/homepage\").text\n\n    settings = homepage.get()\n    assert settings.headline == \"Kenyon, by the numbers,\"\n    assert settings.headline_accent == \"checked twice.\"\n    assert [(f.value, f.label, f.note) for f in settings.key_figures] == [\n        (\"1,805\", \"Students enrolled\", \"Fall 2026 census\"),\n        (\"10:1\", \"Student–faculty ratio\", \"\")]\n\n\ndef test_blank_key_figure_rows_are_dropped_and_the_rest_close_up(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = saved(director, figure_value_1=\"\", figure_label_1=\"\", figure_note_1=\"\",\n                     figure_value_3=\"87%\", figure_label_3=\"Six-year graduation\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert [f.value for f in homepage.get().key_figures] == [\"10:1\", \"87%\"]\n\n\ndef test_the_homepage_may_have_no_key_figures(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    blank = {f\"figure_{part}_{n}\": \"\" for part in (\"value\", \"label\", \"note\") for n in (1, 2)}\n    assert saved(director, **blank).status_code == 303\n    assert homepage.get().key_figures == ()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"override, field\", [\n    ({\"headline\": \"   \"}, \"headline\"),\n    ({\"headline\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"headline\"] + 1)}, \"headline\"),\n    ({\"headline_accent\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"headline_accent\"] + 1)}, \"headline_accent\"),\n    ({\"intro\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"intro\"] + 1)}, \"intro\"),\n    ({\"figure_value_2\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"value\"] + 1)}, \"figure_value_2\"),\n    ({\"figure_label_1\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"label\"] + 1)}, \"figure_label_1\"),\n    ({\"figure_note_1\": \"x\" * (homepage.LIMITS[\"note\"] + 1)}, \"figure_note_1\"),\n    # Half a Key figure: a number with nothing to say what it counts.\n    ({\"figure_label_2\": \"\"}, \"figure_label_2\"),\n    ({\"figure_value_2\": \"\"}, \"figure_value_2\"),\n])\ndef test_a_field_over_its_limit_or_missing_is_refused_by_the_field(client_as, override, field):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    before = homepage.get()\n    response = saved(director, **override)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert homepage.get() == before\n    # The message sits by its field, and what was typed is kept.\n    assert re.search(rf'name=\"{field}\"[^>]*aria-invalid=\"true\"[^>]*aria-describedby=\"{field}-error\"',\n                     response.text), field\n    assert f'id=\"{field}-error\"' in response.text\n    assert 'value=\"Kenyon, by the numbers,\"' in response.text or field == \"headline\"\n\n\ndef test_settings_are_plain_text_and_escaped_on_the_form(client_as):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert saved(director, headline='<b>Bold</b> \"claims\"').status_code == 303\n    assert homepage.get().headline == '<b>Bold</b> \"claims\"'\n    page = director.get(\"/admin/homepage\").text\n    assert \"<b>Bold</b>\" not in page and \"&lt;b&gt;Bold&lt;/b&gt;\" in
