{"parentUuid":"de42fc29-fc27-41ab-9fc7-78f910850e33","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfbzYXZXMZdaFCAUtLdtw","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01W4xydDnK7iWk94gmq9Lkvu","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/homepage.py","content":"\"\"\"Homepage settings: the homepage's headline, the accent that ends it, its\nintro, and up to four Key figures (spec #22).\n\nThey are settings, not content: one row, no Draft, edited by the Director\nonly (the routes enforce that), and on the public site from the next\n`cms publish`, like a change to the nav. Everything is plain text, escaped\nwhere it is shown. A fresh database is seeded with SAMPLE, so a new site has\na homepage to look at; the Director replaces its figures with real ones.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nFIGURES_MAX = 4\n# Each field's limit in characters, the Key figures' by part.\nLIMITS = {\"headline\": 80, \"headline_accent\": 60, \"intro\": 300,\n          \"value\": 16, \"label\": 40, \"note\": 40}\n\n\nclass SettingsError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A setting broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` is the\n    form field it is about, e.g. \"intro\" or \"figure_label_2\".\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass KeyFigure:\n    value: str  # e.g. \"1,805\"\n    label: str  # what it counts, e.g. \"Students enrolled\"\n    note: str   # optional: when or of whom, e.g. \"Fall 2026 census\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Homepage:\n    headline: str\n    headline_accent: str  # shown after the headline, in bright purple\n    intro: str\n    key_figures: tuple[KeyFigure, ...]\n\n\nSAMPLE = Homepage(\n    headline=\"The college's numbers,\", headline_accent=\"the day they're final.\",\n    intro=\"Enrollment, retention, outcomes and survey results from Kenyon's \"\n          \"Office of Institutional Research.\",\n    key_figures=(KeyFigure(\"1,805\", \"Students enrolled\", \"Fall 2026 census\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"91%\", \"First-year retention\", \"Class entering 2025\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"10:1\", \"Student–faculty ratio\", \"Fall 2026\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"87%\", \"Six-year graduation\", \"Class entering 2020\")))\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS homepage (\n    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),  -- one row only\n    headline        TEXT NOT NULL,\n    headline_accent TEXT NOT NULL,\n    intro           TEXT NOT NULL,\n    key_figures     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON: [{\"value\", \"label\", \"note\"}], at most four\n    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _row(settings: Homepage) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:\n    return (settings.headline, settings.headline_accent, settings.intro,\n            json.dumps([asdict(figure) for figure in settings.key_figures]))\n\n\ndef seed(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Make the table, with SAMPLE in it if it has no row yet (db.init_db).\"\"\"\n    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO homepage\"\n                 \" (id, headline, headline_accent, intro, key_figures)\"\n                 \" VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?)\", _row(SAMPLE))\n\n\ndef get() -> Homepage:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM homepage WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return Homepage(row[\"headline\"], row[\"headline_accent\"], row[\"intro\"],\n                    tuple(KeyFigure(**figure) for figure in json.loads(row[\"key_figures\"])))\n\n\ndef _text(form: Mapping[str, str], field: str, limit: str, what: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A field's text as saved, its runs of whitespace as single spaces.\"\"\"\n    text = \" \".join(str(form.get(field, \"\")).split())\n    if len(text) > LIMITS[limit]:\n        raise SettingsError(f\"Keep {what} to {LIMITS[limit]} characters or fewer; \"\n                            f\"it has {len(text)}.\", field)\n    return text\n\n\ndef from_form(form: Mapping[str, str]) -> Homepage:\n    \"\"\"The settings a posted form gives: headline, headline_accent, intro,\n    and figure_value_<n>, figure_label_<n>, figure_note_<n> for n from 1 to\n    FIGURES_MAX. A blank Key figure row is dropped and the rest close up; a\n    row with a value needs a label, and the other way round. SettingsError\n    on the first field that breaks a rule.\"\"\"\n    headline = _text(form, \"headline\", \"headline\", \"the headline\")\n    if not headline:\n        raise SettingsError(\"Enter a headline.\", \"headline\")\n    accent = _text(form, \"headline_accent\", \"headline_accent\", \"the accent\")\n    intro = _text(form, \"intro\", \"intro\", \"the intro\")\n    figures = []\n    for n in range(1, FIGURES_MAX + 1):\n        value, label, note = (_text(form, f\"figure_{part}_{n}\", part, f\"a figure's {part}\")\n                              for part in (\"value\", \"label\", \"note\"))\n        if not (value or label or note):\n            continue\n        if not value:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Enter the figure itself, e.g. 1,805.\", f\"figure_value_{n}\")\n        if not label:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Say what the figure counts, e.g. Students enrolled.\",\n                                f\"figure_label_{n}\")\n        figures.append(KeyFigure(value, label, note))\n    return Homepage(headline, accent, intro, tuple(figures))\n\n\ndef form_of(settings: Homepage) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"`settings` as the edit form's fields, the inverse of from_form; a\n    row past its Key figures is blank.\"\"\"\n    form = {\"headline\": settings.headline, \"headline_accent\": settings.headline_accent,\n            \"intro\": settings.intro}\n    for n in range(1, FIGURES_MAX + 1):\n        figure = (settings.key_figures[n - 1] if n <= len(settings.key_figures)\n                  else KeyFigure(\"\", \"\", \"\"))\n        form.update({f\"figure_value_{n}\": figure.value, f\"figure_label_{n}\": figure.label,\n                     f\"figure_note_{n}\": figure.note})\n    return form\n\n\ndef save(settings: Homepage) -> None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE homepage SET headline = ?, headline_accent = ?, intro = ?,\"\n                     \" key_figures = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 1\",\n                     _row(settings))\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":296,"cache_read_input_tokens":168628,"output_tokens":2448,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":296,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2448,"cache_read_input_tokens":168628,"cache_creation_input_tokens":296,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":296},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01W4xydDnK7iWk94gmq9Lkvu":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/app/homepage.py","content":"\"\"\"Homepage settings: the homepage's headline, the accent that ends it, its\nintro, and up to four Key figures (spec #22).\n\nThey are settings, not content: one row, no Draft, edited by the Director\nonly (the routes enforce that), and on the public site from the next\n`cms publish`, like a change to the nav. Everything is plain text, escaped\nwhere it is shown. A fresh database is seeded with SAMPLE, so a new site has\na homepage to look at; the Director replaces its figures with real ones.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import asdict, dataclass\n\nfrom app import db\n\nFIGURES_MAX = 4\n# Each field's limit in characters, the Key figures' by part.\nLIMITS = {\"headline\": 80, \"headline_accent\": 60, \"intro\": 300,\n          \"value\": 16, \"label\": 40, \"note\": 40}\n\n\nclass SettingsError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A setting broke a rule; the message is safe to show. `field` is the\n    form field it is about, e.g. \"intro\" or \"figure_label_2\".\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str, field: str):\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.field = field\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass KeyFigure:\n    value: str  # e.g. \"1,805\"\n    label: str  # what it counts, e.g. \"Students enrolled\"\n    note: str   # optional: when or of whom, e.g. \"Fall 2026 census\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Homepage:\n    headline: str\n    headline_accent: str  # shown after the headline, in bright purple\n    intro: str\n    key_figures: tuple[KeyFigure, ...]\n\n\nSAMPLE = Homepage(\n    headline=\"The college's numbers,\", headline_accent=\"the day they're final.\",\n    intro=\"Enrollment, retention, outcomes and survey results from Kenyon's \"\n          \"Office of Institutional Research.\",\n    key_figures=(KeyFigure(\"1,805\", \"Students enrolled\", \"Fall 2026 census\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"91%\", \"First-year retention\", \"Class entering 2025\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"10:1\", \"Student–faculty ratio\", \"Fall 2026\"),\n                 KeyFigure(\"87%\", \"Six-year graduation\", \"Class entering 2020\")))\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS homepage (\n    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),  -- one row only\n    headline        TEXT NOT NULL,\n    headline_accent TEXT NOT NULL,\n    intro           TEXT NOT NULL,\n    key_figures     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- JSON: [{\"value\", \"label\", \"note\"}], at most four\n    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _row(settings: Homepage) -> tuple[str, str, str, str]:\n    return (settings.headline, settings.headline_accent, settings.intro,\n            json.dumps([asdict(figure) for figure in settings.key_figures]))\n\n\ndef seed(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Make the table, with SAMPLE in it if it has no row yet (db.init_db).\"\"\"\n    conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO homepage\"\n                 \" (id, headline, headline_accent, intro, key_figures)\"\n                 \" VALUES (1, ?, ?, ?, ?)\", _row(SAMPLE))\n\n\ndef get() -> Homepage:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM homepage WHERE id = 1\").fetchone()\n    return Homepage(row[\"headline\"], row[\"headline_accent\"], row[\"intro\"],\n                    tuple(KeyFigure(**figure) for figure in json.loads(row[\"key_figures\"])))\n\n\ndef _text(form: Mapping[str, str], field: str, limit: str, what: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A field's text as saved, its runs of whitespace as single spaces.\"\"\"\n    text = \" \".join(str(form.get(field, \"\")).split())\n    if len(text) > LIMITS[limit]:\n        raise SettingsError(f\"Keep {what} to {LIMITS[limit]} characters or fewer; \"\n                            f\"it has {len(text)}.\", field)\n    return text\n\n\ndef from_form(form: Mapping[str, str]) -> Homepage:\n    \"\"\"The settings a posted form gives: headline, headline_accent, intro,\n    and figure_value_<n>, figure_label_<n>, figure_note_<n> for n from 1 to\n    FIGURES_MAX. A blank Key figure row is dropped and the rest close up; a\n    row with a value needs a label, and the other way round. SettingsError\n    on the first field that breaks a rule.\"\"\"\n    headline = _text(form, \"headline\", \"headline\", \"the headline\")\n    if not headline:\n        raise SettingsError(\"Enter a headline.\", \"headline\")\n    accent = _text(form, \"headline_accent\", \"headline_accent\", \"the accent\")\n    intro = _text(form, \"intro\", \"intro\", \"the intro\")\n    figures = []\n    for n in range(1, FIGURES_MAX + 1):\n        value, label, note = (_text(form, f\"figure_{part}_{n}\", part, f\"a figure's {part}\")\n                              for part in (\"value\", \"label\", \"note\"))\n        if not (value or label or note):\n            continue\n        if not value:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Enter the figure itself, e.g. 1,805.\", f\"figure_value_{n}\")\n        if not label:\n            raise SettingsError(\"Say what the figure counts, e.g. Students enrolled.\",\n                                f\"figure_label_{n}\")\n        figures.append(KeyFigure(value, label, note))\n    return Homepage(headline, accent, intro, tuple(figures))\n\n\ndef form_of(settings: Homepage) -> dict[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"`settings` as the edit form's fields, the inverse of from_form; a\n    row past its Key figures is blank.\"\"\"\n    form = {\"headline\": settings.headline, \"headline_accent\": settings.headline_accent,\n            \"intro\": settings.intro}\n    for n in range(1, FIGURES_MAX + 1):\n        figure = (settings.key_figures[n - 1] if n <= len(settings.key_figures)\n                  else KeyFigure(\"\", \"\", \"\"))\n        form.update({f\"figure_value_{n}\": figure.value, f\"figure_label_{n}\": figure.label,\n                     f\"figure_note_{n}\": figure.note})\n    return form\n\n\ndef save(settings: Homepage) -> None:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE homepage SET headline = ?, headline_accent = ?, intro = ?,\"\n                     \" key_figures = ?, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 1\",\n                     _row(settings))\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"c21b70ff-72e6-4a68-be03-62c7ac7911d8","apiBlockIndex":0,"requestId":"req_011CfbzYX9Dw33GPjbQa7RB8","type":"assistant","uuid":"2f1343aa-9f29-49de-81ba-943e0fe98ce3","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:30:32.296Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

A refused field shows\n    its message beside it, and the form keeps what was typed. #}\n{% macro field(name, label, limit, hint=\"\", rows=0) %}\n  {%- set invalid = error_field == name %}\n  {%- set describedby = (name ~ \"-error\") if invalid else (name ~ \"-hint\") %}\n  <p class=\"admin-homepage-field\"><label for=\"{{ name }}\">{{ label }}</label>\n    {%- if rows %}\n    <textarea id=\"{{ name }}\" name=\"{{ name }}\" rows=\"{{ rows }}\" cols=\"60\"{% if invalid %} aria-invalid=\"true\"{% endif %} aria-describedby=\"{{ describedby }}\">{{ form[name] }}</textarea>\n    {%- else %}\n    <input type=\"text\" id=\"{{ name }}\" name=\"{{ name }}\" value=\"{{ form[name] }}\"{% if invalid %} aria-invalid=\"true\"{% endif %} aria-describedby=\"{{ describedby }}\">\n    {%- endif %}\n    {%- if invalid %}\n    <small id=\"{{ name }}-error\" class=\"admin-field-error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</small>\n    {%- else %}\n    <small id=\"{{ name }}-hint\">{{ hint }}{% if hint %} {% endif %}Up to {{ limit }} characters.</small>\n    {%- endif %}</p>\n{%- endmacro %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Admin console</a></p>\n  <h1>Homepage settings</h1>\n  <p>What the public homepage shows above the latest Data Bite. Saved here, it reaches the site at the next <code>cms publish</code>; it has no Draft.</p>\n  <form class=\"admin-homepage\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ path_for('save_homepage') }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    {{ field(\"headline\", \"Headline\", limits.headline, \"Required.\") }}\n    {{ field(\"headline_accent\", \"Headline accent (optional)\", limits.headline_accent,\n             \"Shown after the headline, in bright purple.\") }}\n    {{ field(\"intro\", \"Intro (optional)\", limits.intro, \"A sentence under the headline.\", rows=3) }}\n    <fieldset class=\"admin-homepage-figures\">\n      <legend>Key figures</legend>\n      <p id=\"figures-hint\">Up to {{ figures_max }}, shown in this order. Each needs its figure and what it counts; leave a row blank to drop it.</p>\n      {%- for n in range(1, figures_max + 1) %}\n      <fieldset class=\"admin-homepage-figure\">\n        <legend>Key figure {{ n }}</legend>\n        {{ field(\"figure_value_\" ~ n, \"Figure\", limits.value, \"e.g. 1,805 or 91%.\") }}\n        {{ field(\"figure_label_\" ~ n, \"What it counts\", limits.label, \"e.g. Students enrolled.\") }}\n        {{ field(\"figure_note_\" ~ n, \"Note (optional)\", limits.note, \"When or of whom, e.g. Fall 2026 census.\") }}\n      </fieldset>\n      {%- endfor %}\n    </fieldset>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Save homepage</button></p>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2180,"cache_read_input_tokens":171455,"output_tokens":1988,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":292},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2180,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1988,"cache_read_input_tokens":171455,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2180,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2180},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01KXVyUwN9xHdtJLYU1VpL1t":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/templates/admin/homepage.html","content":"{% extends \"base.html\" %}\n{#- Homepage settings (app.homepage): Director only. A refused field shows\n    its message beside it, and the form keeps what was typed. #}\n{% macro field(name, label, limit, hint=\"\", rows=0) %}\n  {%- set invalid = error_field == name %}\n  {%- set describedby = (name ~ \"-error\") if invalid else (name ~ \"-hint\") %}\n  <p class=\"admin-homepage-field\"><label for=\"{{ name }}\">{{ label }}</label>\n    {%- if rows %}\n    <textarea id=\"{{ name }}\" name=\"{{ name }}\" rows=\"{{ rows }}\" cols=\"60\"{% if invalid %} aria-invalid=\"true\"{% endif %} aria-describedby=\"{{ describedby }}\">{{ form[name] }}</textarea>\n    {%- else %}\n    <input type=\"text\" id=\"{{ name }}\" name=\"{{ name }}\" value=\"{{ form[name] }}\"{% if invalid %} aria-invalid=\"true\"{% endif %} aria-describedby=\"{{ describedby }}\">\n    {%- endif %}\n    {%- if invalid %}\n    <small id=\"{{ name }}-error\" class=\"admin-field-error\" role=\"alert\">{{ error }}</small>\n    {%- else %}\n    <small id=\"{{ name }}-hint\">{{ hint }}{% if hint %} {% endif %}Up to {{ limit }} characters.</small>\n    {%- endif %}</p>\n{%- endmacro %}\n{% block content %}\n  <p><a href=\"{{ path_for('admin_home') }}\">Admin console</a></p>\n  <h1>Homepage settings</h1>\n  <p>What the public homepage shows above the latest Data Bite. Saved here, it reaches the site at the next <code>cms publish</code>; it has no Draft.</p>\n  <form class=\"admin-homepage\" method=\"post\" action=\"{{ path_for('save_homepage') }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    {{ field(\"headline\", \"Headline\", limits.headline, \"Required.\") }}\n    {{ field(\"headline_accent\", \"Headline accent (optional)\", limits.headline_accent,\n             \"Shown after the headline, in bright purple.\") }}\n    {{ field(\"intro\", \"Intro (optional)\", limits.intro, \"A sentence under the headline.\", rows=3) }}\n    <fieldset class=\"admin-homepage-figures\">\n      <legend>Key figures</legend>\n      <p id=\"figures-hint\">Up to {{ figures_max }}, shown in this order. Each needs its figure and what it counts; leave a row blank to drop it.</p>\n      {%- for n in range(1, figures_max + 1) %}\n      <fieldset class=\"admin-homepage-figure\">\n        <legend>Key figure {{ n }}</legend>\n        {{ field(\"figure_value_\" ~ n, \"Figure\", limits.value, \"e.g. 1,805 or 91%.\") }}\n        {{ field(\"figure_label_\" ~ n, \"What it counts\", limits.label, \"e.g. Students enrolled.\") }}\n        {{ field(\"figure_note_\" ~ n, \"Note (optional)\", limits.note, \"When or of whom, e.g. Fall 2026 census.\") }}\n      </fieldset>\n      {%- endfor %}\n    </fieldset>\n    <p><button type=\"submit\">Save homepage</button></p>\n  </form>\n{% endblock %}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"72774d67-4f69-4363-a9df-55d5b06fe679","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"6e574ec7-f802-4741-9186-3e4e69a1ad33","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c6ed7c30-2e77-4b00-90fa-1a6326c826a8","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","content":"Exit code 1\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Director (admin) and one Analyst (editor), with passwords read from\n.env, never hard-coded, and demo content: a published and a draft Data Bite,\nand a published and a draft Report, so the public site and the admin console\nboth have something to show. Safe to re-run: an existing account, or an item\nwhose slug is already taken, is left alone.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import data_bites, db, reports, settings, users\n\n# Keep in step with DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py.\nDEMO_ACCOUNTS = [\n    (\"admin@example.test\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\", \"admin\", \"Demo Director\"),\n    (\"editor@example.test\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\", \"editor\", \"Demo Analyst\"),\n]\n\n_DEMO_NOTE = \"*Demo content from scripts/seed_demo.py; the figures are made up.*\"\n\n# (module, title, slug, body, author's email, published?)\nDEMO_CONTENT = [\n    (data_bites, \"Fall enrollment snapshot\", \"fall-enrollment-snapshot\",\n     \"Headcount by class on the census date.\\n\\n\"\n     \"| Class | Students | Change |\\n|:--|--:|--:|\\n\"\n     \"| First-year | 480 | +2% |\\n| Sophomore | 455 | -1% |\\n\"\n     \"| Junior | 440 | 0% |\\n| Senior | 430 | +1% |\\n\\n\" + _DEMO_NOTE,\n     \"editor@example.test\", True),\n    (data_bites, \"Spring survey response rates\", \"spring-survey-response-rates\",\n     \"Response rates for the spring student survey, still being checked \"\n     \"before release.\\n\\n\" + _DEMO_NOTE,\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from a branch -> \"\n                  \"gh-pages / root, then wait up to 10 minutes.\")\n        return result.returncode\n    return 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())","is_error":true,"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MkfTiRHxWUqi4K3g8KHBRq"}]},"uuid":"484cf738-b8d9-45e7-b2a1-966a1121e4e5","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:31:21.546Z","toolUseResult":"Error: Exit code 1\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Director (admin) and one Analyst (editor), with passwords read from\n.env, never hard-coded, and demo content: a published and a draft Data Bite,\nand a published and a draft Report, so the public site and the admin console\nboth have something to show. admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. Preview it with:  python3 -m http.server -d {out} 8001\")\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"deploy\":\n        if not settings.SITE.exists():\n            print(\"site/ does not exist yet — run `uv run cms publish` first.\")\n            return 1\n        result = subprocess.run(\n            [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", args.message,\n             str(settings.SITE)],\n        )\n        if result.returncode == 0:\n            print(\"Pushed to gh-pages. {"parentUuid":"f936c2b1-9db3-4970-9743-54c566c55e07","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc1QZD9ciNz7SAeRkyXE","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01K8yRGNg39n4GE3iw84TvpN","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat >> tests/test_t20_homepage.py <<'EOF'\n\n\n# The home page\n\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import published_bite, published_report  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.test_t16_charts import fence, source  # noqa: E402\nfrom tests.conftest import backdate  # noqa: E402\n\nCHART_BODY = (\"Headcount by class.\\n\\n\" + fence(source(title=\"Headcount by class\"))\n              + \"\\nMore prose.\\n\\n\" + fence(source(title=\"A second chart\")))\n\n\ndef section(page: str, heading: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A home section's HTML, from its heading to the next section.\"\"\"\n    start = page.index(f\">{heading}</h2>\")\n    end = page.find('<section class=\"section-home\"', start)\n    return page[start:end if end != -1 else len(page)]\n\n\ndef test_the_home_page_shows_the_homepage_settings(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert saved(director).status_code == 303\n    page = client.get(\"/\").text\n    assert re.search(r'<h1 id=\"intro-home-title\">Kenyon, by the numbers,\\s*'\n                     r'<span class=\"intro-home-accent\">checked twice\\.</span></h1>', page)\n    assert '<p class=\"intro-home-lede\">Enrollment and outcomes from the census.</p>' in page\n    figures = re.findall(r\"<div><dt>([^<]+)(?:<small>([^<]*)</small>)?</dt><dd>([^<]+)</dd></div>\", page)\n    assert figures == [(\"Students enrolled\", \"Fall 2026 census\", \"1,805\"),\n                       (\"Student–faculty ratio\", \"\", \"10:1\")]\n    # Its intro is the page's description too.\n    assert '<meta name=\"description\" content=\"Enrollment and outcomes from the census.\">' in page\n\n\ndef test_the_home_page_escapes_the_settings(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert saved(director, headline=\"<i>Numbers</i>\", figure_value_1=\"<b>1</b>\").status_code == 303\n    page = client.get(\"/\").text\n    assert \"<i>Numbers</i>\" not in page and \"&lt;i&gt;Numbers&lt;/i&gt;\" in page\n    assert \"<b>1</b>\" not in page and \"&lt;b&gt;1&lt;/b&gt;\" in page\n\n\ndef test_no_key_figures_leaves_out_their_list(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    blank = {f\"figure_{part}_{n}\": \"\" for part in (\"value\", \"label\", \"note\") for n in (1, 2)}\n    assert saved(director, **blank).status_code == 303\n    assert \"figures-home\" not in client.get(\"/\").text\n\n\ndef test_the_home_sections_are_latest_reports_then_data_bites(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    older = published_bite(director, slug=\"older\", title=\"Older bite\", summary=\"An older one.\")\n    backdate(\"data_bites\", older)\n    published_bite(director, summary=\"The newest one.\")\n    published_report(director, summary=\"What the Factbook covers.\")\n    page = client.get(\"/\").text\n    numbers = re.findall(r'<div class=\"section-head\"><span class=\"text-mono\">(\\d\\d)</span><h2 [^>]*>([^<]+)</h2>', page)\n    assert numbers == [(\"01\", \"Latest\"), (\"02\", \"Reports\"), (\"03\", \"Data Bites\")]\n\n    latest = section(page, \"Latest\")\n    assert BITE[\"title\"] in latest and \"The newest one.\" in latest\n    assert 'href=\"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\"' in latest\n    # {"parentUuid":"46ef51a8-a9ee-467c-a260-08b6d8dc7c43","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc28erdiFB5J3fyuPmLQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BuQnNNBL1UXuF8c75gZzS6","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t20_search.py","content":"\"\"\"T20: Site search (issue #24, spec #22).\n\nStatic: `cms publish` writes search-index.json (published items only) and\nsearch.html, and search.js searches the index in the browser. Without\nJavaScript, search.html lists every published item. The app serves all\nthree, so search works in local preview too.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t19_look_and_feel import PUBLIC_PAGES\n\nDRAFT_TITLE = \"Unreleased census count\"\n\n\ndef a_searchable_site(director) -> None:\n    published_bite(director, summary=\"Headcount by class on the census date.\")\n    published_report(director, summary=\"Admissions, enrollment, and programs.\")\n    create_bite(director, slug=\"unreleased\", title=DRAFT_TITLE, summary=\"Not yet final.\")\n    create_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Draft CDS\", summary=\"Draft summary words.\")\n\n\n# The index\n\ndef test_the_index_holds_published_items_only(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n    index = response.json()\n    assert index == [\n        {\"kind\": \"Report\", \"title\": \"Factbook 2026\", \"summary\": \"Admissions, enrollment, and programs.\",\n         \"date\": index[0][\"date\"], \"path\": \"reports/factbook.html\"},\n        {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": BITE[\"title\"],\n         \"summary\": \"Headcount by class on the census date.\",\n         \"date\": index[1][\"date\"], \"path\": \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\"}]\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", item[\"date\"]) for item in index)\n    for draft_word in (DRAFT_TITLE, \"Not yet final\", \"Draft CDS\", \"Draft summary\"):\n        assert draft_word not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_every_path_in_the_index_is_a_page_of_the_site(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json():\n        assert not item[\"path\"].startswith(\"/\")\n        assert client.get(\"/\" + item[\"path\"]).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_takes_an_item_out_of_the_index(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    bite = published_bite(director)\n    from tests.conftest import post_form\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}/unpublish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# search.html\n\ndef test_search_html_lists_every_published_item_without_javascript(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n    results = re.findall(r'<li><a href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a>', page)\n    assert results == [(\"reports/factbook.html\", \"Factbook 2026\"),\n                       (\"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", BITE[\"title\"])]\n    assert \"Headcount by class on the census date.\" in page\n    assert DRAFT_TITLE not in page and \"Draft CDS\" not in page\n    assert '<script src=\"search.js\" defer></script>' in page\n\n\ndef test_search_html_with_nothing_published(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200 and \"Nothing is published yet.\" in page.text\n\n\ndef test_the_script_is_served_as_javascript(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/search.js\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/javascript\")\n    assert response.text == (settings.STATIC / \"search.js\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_the_index_the_page_and_the_script(client_as, tmp_path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    a_searchable_site(director)\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert json.loads(site[\"search-index.json\"]) == public_site.search_index()\n    assert site[\"search.js\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"search.js\").read_bytes()\n    for name in (\"search-index.json\", \"search.html\"):\n        text = site[name].decode()\n        assert DRAFT_TITLE not in text and \"Draft CDS\" not in text, name\n        assert \"Factbook 2026\" in text, name\n\n\n# The header form\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", PUBLIC_PAGES + [\"/search.html\"])\ndef test_every_page_has_the_search_form(client_as, client, path):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(path).text\n    root = \"../\" * path.removeprefix(\"/\").count(\"/\")\n    form = re.search(r'<form class=\"search-site\" role=\"search\" action=\"([^\"]+)\" method=\"get\">(.*?)</form>',\n                     page, re.S)\n    assert form, path\n    assert form.group(1) == f\"{root}search.html\"\n    assert re.search(r'<label [^>]*for=\"search-site-q\"', form.group(2))\n    assert re.search(r'<input [^>]*id=\"search-site-q\"[^>]*name=\"q\"', form.group(2))\n\n\n# search.js's matching, run in Node where there is one (no dependency).\n\nINDEX = [\n    {\"kind\": \"Report\", \"title\": \"Factbook\", \"summary\": \"Retention and enrollment, each term.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-09-29\", \"path\": \"reports/factbook.html\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": \"First-year retention holds\", \"summary\": \"The class returned.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-09-12\", \"path\": \"data-bites/retention.html\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": \"Résumé workshop survey\", \"summary\": \"Career office results.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-08-01\", \"path\": \"data-bites/resume.html\"},\n]\n\n\ndef search(query: str) -> list[str]:\n    script = (f\"const {{searchItems}} = require({json.dumps(str(settings.STATIC / 'search.js'))});\"\n              f\"console.log(JSON.stringify(searchItems({json.dumps(INDEX)}, {json.dumps(query)})\"\n              \".map(item => item.title)));\")\n    out = subprocess.run([\"node\", \"-e\", script], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)\n    return json.loads(out.stdout)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which(\"node\") is None, reason=\"Node isn't installed\")\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"query, titles\", [\n    # A title match ranks above a match in a summary alone.\n    (\"retention\", [\"First-year retention holds\", \"Factbook\"]),\n    (\"RETENTION\", [\"First-year retention holds\", \"Factbook\"]),\n    # Accents are ignored both ways.\n    (\"resume\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    (\"Résumé\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    # In a summary only.\n    (\"career\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    # Every word must match, in the title or the summary.\n    (\"factbook enrollment\", [\"Factbook\"]),\n    (\"factbook career\", []),\n    (\"no such thing\", []),\n    (\"   \", []),\n])\ndef test_search_js_matches_and_ranks(query, titles):\n    assert search(query) == titles\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1895,"cache_read_input_tokens":235123,"output_tokens":2904,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":157},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1895,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2904,"cache_read_input_tokens":235123,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1895,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1895},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01BuQnNNBL1UXuF8c75gZzS6":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/tests/test_t20_search.py","content":"\"\"\"T20: Without\nJavaScript, search.html lists every published item. The app serves all\nthree, so search works in local preview too.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport re\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import public_site, settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom tests.test_t03_data_bites import BITE, create_bite\nfrom tests.test_t04_reports import create_report\nfrom tests.test_t07_public_site import published_bite, published_report\nfrom tests.test_t08_publish import exported\nfrom tests.test_t19_look_and_feel import PUBLIC_PAGES\n\nDRAFT_TITLE = \"Unreleased census count\"\n\n\ndef a_searchable_site(director) -> None:\n    published_bite(director, summary=\"Headcount by class on the census date.\")\n    published_report(director, summary=\"Admissions, enrollment, and programs.\")\n    create_bite(director, slug=\"unreleased\", title=DRAFT_TITLE, summary=\"Not yet final.\")\n    create_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Draft CDS\", summary=\"Draft summary words.\")\n\n\n# The index\n\ndef test_the_index_holds_published_items_only(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    response = client.get(\"/search-index.json\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"application/json\")\n    assert response.headers[\"x-content-type-options\"] == \"nosniff\"\n    index = response.json()\n    assert index == [\n        {\"kind\": \"Report\", \"title\": \"Factbook 2026\", \"summary\": \"Admissions, enrollment, and programs.\",\n         \"date\": index[0][\"date\"], \"path\": \"reports/factbook.html\"},\n        {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": BITE[\"title\"],\n         \"summary\": \"Headcount by class on the census date.\",\n         \"date\": index[1][\"date\"], \"path\": \"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\"}]\n    assert all(re.fullmatch(r\"\\d{4}-\\d\\d-\\d\\d\", item[\"date\"]) for item in index)\n    for draft_word in (DRAFT_TITLE, \"Not yet final\", \"Draft CDS\", \"Draft summary\"):\n        assert draft_word not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_every_path_in_the_index_is_a_page_of_the_site(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    for item in client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json():\n        assert not item[\"path\"].startswith(\"/\")\n        assert client.get(\"/\" + item[\"path\"]).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_unpublishing_takes_an_item_out_of_the_index(client_as, client):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    bite = published_bite(director)\n    from tests.conftest import post_form\n    assert post_form(director, f\"/admin/data-bites/{bite}/unpublish\", {}).status_code == 303\n    assert client.get(\"/search-index.json\").json() == []\n\n\n# search.html\n\ndef test_search_html_lists_every_published_item_without_javascript(client_as, client):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\").text\n    results = re.findall(r'<li><a href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a>', page)\n    assert results == [(\"reports/factbook.html\", \"Factbook 2026\"),\n                       (\"data-bites/fall-enrollment.html\", BITE[\"title\"])]\n    assert \"Headcount by class on the census date.\" in page\n    assert DRAFT_TITLE not in page and \"Draft CDS\" not in page\n    assert '<script src=\"search.js\" defer></script>' in page\n\n\ndef test_search_html_with_nothing_published(client):\n    page = client.get(\"/search.html\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200 and \"Nothing is published yet.\" in page.text\n\n\ndef test_the_script_is_served_as_javascript(client):\n    response = client.get(\"/search.js\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert response.headers[\"content-type\"].startswith(\"text/javascript\")\n    assert response.text == (settings.STATIC / \"search.js\").read_text()\n\n\ndef test_publish_writes_the_index_the_page_and_the_script(client_as, tmp_path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    a_searchable_site(director)\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    assert json.loads(site[\"search-index.json\"]) == public_site.search_index()\n    assert site[\"search.js\"] == (settings.STATIC / \"search.js\").read_bytes()\n    for name in (\"search-index.json\", \"search.html\"):\n        text = site[name].decode()\n        assert DRAFT_TITLE not in text and \"Draft CDS\" not in text, name\n        assert \"Factbook 2026\" in text, name\n\n\n# The header form\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path\", PUBLIC_PAGES + [\"/search.html\"])\ndef test_every_page_has_the_search_form(client_as, client, path):\n    a_searchable_site(client_as(\"admin\"))\n    page = client.get(path).text\n    root = \"../\" * path.removeprefix(\"/\").count(\"/\")\n    form = re.search(r'<form class=\"search-site\" role=\"search\" action=\"([^\"]+)\" method=\"get\">(.*?)</form>',\n                     page, re.S)\n    assert form, path\n    assert form.group(1) == f\"{root}search.html\"\n    assert re.search(r'<label [^>]*for=\"search-site-q\"', form.group(2))\n    assert re.search(r'<input [^>]*id=\"search-site-q\"[^>]*name=\"q\"', form.group(2))\n\n\n# search.js's matching, run in Node where there is one (no dependency).\n\nINDEX = [\n    {\"kind\": \"Report\", \"title\": \"Factbook\", \"summary\": \"Retention and enrollment, each term.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-09-29\", \"path\": \"reports/factbook.html\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": \"First-year retention holds\", \"summary\": \"The class returned.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-09-12\", \"path\": \"data-bites/retention.html\"},\n    {\"kind\": \"Data Bite\", \"title\": \"Résumé workshop survey\", \"summary\": \"Career office results.\",\n     \"date\": \"2026-08-01\", \"path\": \"data-bites/resume.html\"},\n]\n\n\ndef search(query: str) -> list[str]:\n    script = (f\"const {{searchItems}} = require({json.dumps(str(settings.STATIC / 'search.js'))});\"\n              f\"console.log(JSON.stringify(searchItems({json.dumps(INDEX)}, {json.dumps(query)})\"\n              \".map(item => item.title)));\")\n    out = subprocess.run([\"node\", \"-e\", script], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)\n    return json.loads(out.stdout)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which(\"node\") is None, reason=\"Node isn't installed\")\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"query, titles\", [\n    # A title match ranks above a match in a summary alone.\n    (\"retention\", [\"First-year retention holds\", \"Factbook\"]),\n    (\"RETENTION\", [\"First-year retention holds\", \"Factbook\"]),\n    # Accents are ignored both ways.\n    (\"resume\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    (\"Résumé\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    # In a summary only.\n    (\"career\", [\"Résumé workshop survey\"]),\n    # Every word must match, in the title or the summary.\n    (\"factbook enrollment\", [\"Factbook\"]),\n    (\"factbook career\", []),\n    (\"no such thing\", []),\n    (\"   \", []),\n])\ndef test_search_js_matches_and_ranks(query, titles):\n    assert search(query) == way round.\nfunction folded(text) {\n  return String(text).normalize(\"NFD\").replace(/\\p{M}/gu, \"\").toLowerCase();\n}\n\n// The items whose title or summary has every word of `query`, the ones with\n// more of the words in their title first, and otherwise in index order.\nfunction searchItems(items, query) {\n  const words = folded(query).split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n  if (!words.length) return [];\n  return items\n    .map((item, order) => {\n      const title = folded(item.title), summary = folded(item.summary);\n      const found = words.every(word => title.includes(word) || {\n    const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(\"q\") || \"\";\n    for (const input of document.querySelectorAll('input[name=\"q\"]')) input.value = query;\n    if (!query.trim()) return;  // the full list stands\n\n    const list = document.querySelector(\".list-search\"), status = document.querySelector(\".search-status\");\n    let index;\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(\"search-index.json\");\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(response.statusText);\n      index = await response.json();\n    } catch {\n      status.textContent = \"Search isn't working right now, so every published item is listed below.\";\n      return;\n    }\n    const found = searchItems(index, query);\n    list.replaceChildren(...found.map(item => {\n      const row =   link.textContent = item.title;\n      facts.className = \"text-label text-mono\";\n      date.dateTime = item.date;\n      date.textContent = item.date;\n      facts.append(date, ` · ${item.kind}`);\n      row.append(link, facts);\n      if (item.summary) {\n        const summary = document.createElement(\"p\");\n        summary.textContent = item.summary;\n        row.append(summary);\n      }\n      return row;\n    }));\n    const quoted = `“${query.trim()}”`;\n    status.textContent = found.length === 0 ? `Nothing published matches ${quoted}.`\n      : `${found.length} ${found.length === 1 ? \"result\" : \"results\"} for ${quoted}, title matches first.`;\n    document.title = `Search: ${query.trim()} · ${document.title.split(\" · \").pop()}`;\n  })();\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":735,"cache_read_input_tokens":240009,"output_tokens":1195,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":735,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"not_available","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1195,"cache_read_input_tokens":240009,"cache_creation_input_tokens":735,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":735},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01CAq71oHJj4aEQGUzNNdC2U":{"file_path":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms/static/search.js","content":"// Vanilla,\n// no build step (ADR-002); every bit of text goes in through textContent.\n\n// Text as search compares it: accents and case folded away, so \"resume\"\n// finds \"Résumé\" and the other way round.\nfunction folded(text) {\n  return String(text).normalize(\"NFD\").replace(/\\p{M}/gu, \"\").toLowerCase();\n}\n\n// The items whose title or summary has every word of `query`, the ones with\n// more of the words in their title first, and otherwise in index order.\nfunction searchItems(items, query) {\n  const words = folded(query).split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n  if (!words.length) return [];\n  return items\n    .map((item, order) => {\n      const title = folded(item.title), summary = folded(item.summary);\n      const found = words.every(word => title.includes(word) || summary.includes(word));\n      return {item, order, found, inTitle: words.filter(word => title.includes(word)).length};\n    })\n    .filter(entry => entry.found)\n    .sort((a, b) => b.inTitle - a.inTitle || a.order - b.order)\n    .map(entry => entry.item);\n}\n\nif (typeof module === \"object\") module.exports = {folded, searchItems};\n\nif (typeof document === \"object\") {\n  (async () => {\n    const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get(\"q\") || \"\";\n    for (const input of document.querySelectorAll('input[name=\"q\"]')) input.value = query;\n    if (!query.trim()) return;  // the full list stands\n\n    const list = document.querySelector(\".list-search\"), status = document.querySelector(\".search-status\");\n    let index;\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(\"search-index.json\");\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(response.statusText);\n      index = await response.json();\n    } catch {\n      status.textContent = \"Search isn't working right now, so every published item is listed below.\";\n      return;\n    }\n    const found = searchItems(index, query);\n    list.replaceChildren(...found.map(item => {\n      const row = document.createElement(\"li\"), link = document.createElement(\"a\");\n      const facts = document.createElement(\"span\"), date = document.createElement(\"time\");\n      link.href = item.path;\n      link.textContent = item.title;\n      facts.className = \"text-label text-mono\";\n      date.dateTime = item.date;\n      date.textContent = item.date;\n      facts.append(date, ` · ${item.kind}`);\n      row.append(link, facts);\n      if (item.summary) {\n        const summary = document.createElement(\"p\");\n        summary.textContent = item.summary;\n        row.append(summary);\n      }\n      return row;\n    }));\n    const quoted = `“${query.trim()}”`;\n    status.textContent = found.length === 0 ? `Nothing published matches ${quoted}.`\n      : `${found.length} ${found.length === 1 ? \"result\" : \"results\"} for ${quoted}, title matches first.`;\n    document.title = `Search: ${query.trim()} · ${document.title.split(\" · \").pop()}`;\n  })();\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"803361ed-10ba-493c-97e8-c17ef1352cea","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

And as\n    crawl() follows every link from the home page, failing on a root-absolute\n    or broken one, every exported link is relative and resolves.\"\"\"\n    publish_a_full_site(client_as(\"admin\"), client_as(\"editor\"))\n\n    site = exported(render_site(tmp_path / \"site\"))\n    live = {path.removeprefix(\"/\"): content for path, content in crawl(client).items()}\n    assert set(site) == set(live)\n    for path, content in site.items():\n        assert content == live[path], path\n\n\ndef test_script_in_a_body_is_inert_in_the_export(client_as, tmp_path):\n    director = client_as(\"admin\")\n    payload = 'Hi <script>alert(1)</script> <img src=\"x.png\" onerror=\"alert(2)\">'\n    published_bite(director, body=payload)","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"f4d40265-11e7-4a60-88c2-ab8cb938fc34","timestamp":"2026-10-01T18:53:07.072Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"    assert \"reports/factbook.html\" not in site and \"reports/files/factbook.pdf\" not in site\n    for content in site.values():\n        assert BITE[\"title\"].encode() not in content and REPORT[\"title\"].encode() not in content\n\n\ndef publish_a_full_site(director: TestClient, analyst: TestClient) -> None:\n    published_bite(analyst)\n    published_bite(analyst, slug=\"spring-survey\", title=\"Spring survey results\")\n    create_bite(analyst, slug=\"unreleased-bite\", title=\"Unreleased enrollment count\")\n    rid = published_report(director)\n    assert post_with_file(director, f\"/admin/reports/{rid}\", REPORT, pdf()).status_code == 303\n    published_report(director, slug=\"cds\", title=\"Common Data Set 2025-26\")\n\n\ndef test_the_export_is_the_live_public_site(client_as, client, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Same pages, same paths, same bytes: one rendering, not two. The header\non every page has the search form, a plain GET to search.html.\n\nTest changed, with its reason: the T07 crawler now also follows a form's\naction and what search.js fetches, so the relative-links rule and the\nexport-equals-live check cover the search files too.\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\nEOF\ngit log --oneline -1; Typed text, not drawn from data.\n_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric\n\n**Site search**:\nThe public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:\n`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and\n`search.js` searches the index in the browser. Without JavaScript,\n`search.html` lists every published item. Bodies are not searched (spec #22,\nT20).\n_Avoid_: search engine, full-text search\n\n**Confirmation**:","originalFile":"# Kenyon Office of Institutional Research (IR) CMS\n\nA CMS for Kenyon College's Office of Institutional Research: a two-person office\n(Director + Analyst/intern staff) that publishes survey results, data briefs,\nand durable reference documents like the Factbook and Common Data Set.\n\n## Language\n\n**Director**:\nThe admin role. Modeled on the real office's Associate VP for Institutional\nResearch — the only person who can publish or edit a Report, manage user\naccounts, and deactivate access.\n_Avoid_: Admin, superuser\n\n**Analyst**:\nThe editor role. Each intern gets their own named Analyst account (see\nADR-003). Can draft and publish Data Bites directly; can draft but not\npublish or edit Reports. Any Analyst may edit any other Analyst's draft\n(shift continuity), though the original author is preserved.\n_Avoid_: Editor, intern (interns are Analysts, not a separate role), staff\n\n**Data Bite**:\nA Post: a short, dated item — a survey result, an enrollment snapshot, an\nannouncement. The frequent, low-stakes content type. Analysts can publish\nthese without Director approval.\n_Avoid_: Update, post, announcement, article\n\n**Report**:\nA Page: a durable, cite-able reference document — the Factbook, a Common Data\nSet, the Survey Coordination Policy. Appears in public navigation. Only the\nDirector can publish or edit a Report, even one an Analyst drafted.\n_Avoid_: Page, document\n\n**Draft**:\nContent (a Data Bite or Report) that has been saved but not published. Never\nappears on the public site. Used for unreleased data, e.g. enrollment numbers\nstill being verified before the official count.\n_Avoid_: Unpublished, pending\n\n**Published**:\nContent visible on the public site. The one-way gate: a Report only crosses\nit with Director action.\n_Avoid_: Live, public\n\n**Chart image**:\nAn *uploaded* PNG, JPEG, or WebP picture (usually a chart made in Excel, R,\nor Tableau) that a Data Bite or Report shows inline, placed in its body with\nthe Editor's \"Insert image\", with a required description, and stored there as\n`image:<name>` (T18). It belongs to its item and is published with\nit (ADR-004). Not a **Chart**, which the CMS draws from data, and not a\nReport's **attached file**, which is a PDF offered for download.\n_Avoid_: figure, graphic, media, attachment\n\n**Chart**:\nA bar, horizontal bar, or line chart the CMS *draws* from data typed or\npasted into it, shown inline in a Data Bite or Report body with its data\navailable as a table (spec #14,\n[ADR-006](docs/adr/ADR-006-charts-drawn-from-data.md)). Stored in the body\nas a `chart` block the writer never sees. Not a **Chart image**, which is made elsewhere and uploaded.\n_Avoid_: graph, plot, visualization\n\n**Chart builder**:\nThe Editor's \"Insert chart\" dialog: a Chart's fields and a grid (categories\ndown, series across) that takes typing or a paste from Excel or Sheets, with\nthe Chart drawn by the server as the writer types and each error beside its\nfield or cell (spec #14, T17). In the body, a Chart shows as a *card*, its\ndrawing with Edit and Remove.\n_Avoid_: chart editor, chart wizard\n\n**Editor**:\nThe visual body editor on a Data Bite's or Report's edit page: a toolbar,\ntables edited in place, Charts, and Chart images, with no Markdown in sight.\nThe body is still stored as Markdown (spec #14,\n[ADR-005](docs/adr/ADR-005-editor-stores-markdown.md)). A part of a body it\ncan't represent is a **locked block**: shown read-only, kept byte for byte.\n_Avoid_: WYSIWYG, rich text, rich-text editor\n\n**Site link**:\nA link in a Data Bite's or Report's body to another Data Bite or Report,\npicked from a list in the Editor and stored by the target's immutable\nreference, its *site reference* (`report:<ref>`, `data-bite:<ref>`), never\nits title, slug, or id.\nIt is a link on the site only while its target is Published; otherwise it\nshows as plain text (spec #14, T14).\n_Avoid_: internal link, cross-reference\n\n**Site preview**:\nA Draft (or unsaved edits) rendered as its public page would look, with the\nsite's nav and stylesheet and a \"Draft preview, not published\" banner. Saves\nnothing and publishes nothing.\n_Avoid_: live view\n\n**Confirmation**:\nThe one-line message the admin console shows, once, after a save, publish,\nupload, delete, or user change succeeds (`app/flash.py`). Fixed text only:\nnever a title, email, filename, or password. A refused action gets an error,\nnot a Confirmation.\n_Avoid_: flash, toast, notification, success message\n\n**Factbook**:\nA specific Report: the office's running reference document of admissions,\nenrollment, diversity, and academic program statistics.\n\n**Common Data Set (CDS)**:\nA specific Report: a standardized annual institutional data submission,\npublished publicly.\n\n**Survey Calendar**:\nA specific Report: the schedule of past, current, and upcoming surveys the\noffice runs (e.g. faculty/staff surveys, external review surveys).\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":90,"oldLines":6,"newStart":90,"newLines":35,"lines":[" nothing and publishes nothing."," _Avoid_: live view"," ","+**Summary**:","+One or two sentences of plain text about a Data Bite or Report, at most 200","+characters, written under its title on the edit form. Shown under the title","+on its page, in the lists and the Reports table, and in its page's","+description and link-preview tags (spec #22, T20). Optional: an item without","+one shows nothing in its place.","+_Avoid_: excerpt, abstract, description, blurb","+","+**Homepage settings**:","+The homepage's headline, its accent (the end of the headline, in bright","+purple), its intro, and its Key figures. Typed text, not drawn from data.","+_Avoid_: stat, KPI, metric","+","+**Site search**:","+The public site's search of published titles and Summaries, entirely static:","+`cms publish` writes `search-index.json` and `search.html`, and","+`search.js` searches the index in the browser. {"parentUuid":"544a40c4-6738-49e3-9755-d77ebc73d2e3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfc2cUkTWqsQ5gFjUCU9H","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I've finished steps 4–6 and committed each one. All 1360 tests pass, and the search tests still pass after the last two small changes.\n\n**`e9088e3` Home page.** It's built from the Homepage settings: the headline with its accent in bright purple, the intro, and the four Key figures. Then come 01 Latest (the newest Data Bite with its Summary and its first Chart), 02 Reports (the table), and 03 the earlier Data Bites. If the latest Data Bite has no Chart, it shows only its title, Summary, and link. A Chart inside a quote or list is skipped.\n\n**Sample data.** `seed_demo.py` now gives every item a Summary, puts Charts on two Data Bites, and adds more Data Bites and Reports, so the whole site has something to show.\n\n**`5886258` Site search.** `cms publish` now writes `search-index.json`, which contains only published items, plus `search.html`. Without JavaScript, `search.html` lists everything published. With it, `search.js` narrows the list: every word must match a title or Summary, case and accents are ignored, and title matches come first. The search form is in the header on every page. The matching is tested in Node, and that test skips on a machine without Node.\n\n**`29b20f9`** adds the four new terms to `CONTEXT.md` and tweaks the search status wording.\n\n**Checked in the browser** on the scratch instance (http://localhost:8001):\n- The home page at desktop width matches the mockup: figures, the featured Chart, the Reports table, and the Data Bites with their Summaries.\n- \"enrollment\", submitted from the header form, gives 2 results with the title match first.\n- \"census\", which appears only in a summary, gives 1 result.\n- \"tuition\" says nothing published matches.\n\n**Test changes, with reasons in the commit messages:**\n- The T07 crawler now also follows form actions and what `search.js` fetches, so the relative-paths and export-matches-live checks cover search.\n- The seed test now expects drafts and published items of each type, each with a Summary, instead of exactly one of each.\n- Two T13 Editor tests had to adapt because the demo bodies now contain Charts. One finds its demo item by slug. {"parentUuid":"0c110a76-cbf7-4df9-93ab-32897a9bc666","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"2f59f156-d548-44ff-91a5-b4b407b9d463","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/davelleat/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Review since e540236 (the last T19 commit). Spec: issue #22 (T20 section); ticket: issue #24."}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"90cee3a3-4c68-4b9b-ba32-53da7f79ff41","timestamp":"2026-10-01T19:02:51.517Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_012oXvQtTUZ4xFYV9cRU3iMQ","session_id":"d5c3385e-b66b-4027-9837-a0bfd3de9dbc","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/davelleat/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"9020c1e3-a9a3-4f69-ac84-7c257e705f41","version":"2.1.285","gitBranch":"main"}

The report follows:\n  **Spec review of T20 (`git diff e540236...HEAD`, 6 commits)**\n  \n  Overall the diff matches the spec closely. The whole suite passes (`uv run pytest`: 1360 passed). All the listed tests exist, in `tests/test_t20_summaries.py`, `tests/test_t20_homepage.py` and `tests/test_t20_search.py`.\n  \n  **(a) Missing or partial**\n  - Nothing material. Every acceptance criterion I checked has code and a test behind it: the Summary rules (200 chars, trimmed, optional, refused by the field, live count, escaped), every place the Summary shows including the Site preview, og:url/og:image left out, the homepage table and its Director-only page with CSRF, the featured Data Bite with and without a Chart, the Reports table and its phone stacking (`static/site.css:199-205`), search-index.json and search.html (published only, no-JS full list), the header form on every page, and the four glossary terms.\n  \n  **(c) Looks implemented, but differs from the spec**\n  1. Confirmation text. The spec says *\"The fixed Confirmation is 'Homepage saved.'\"* `app/routes/homepage.py:44` sends `\"Homepage saved.\" + SITE_NOTE`, which shows as \"Homepage saved. The public site updates at the next cms publish.\" The test only checks with `in` (`tests/test_t20_homepage.py:78`). Either drop SITE_NOTE or record that the spec's text was extended.\n  2. og:title and og:type. The spec says *\"Where a Summary shows: … in `<meta name=\"description\">`, `og:title`, `og:description`, and `og:type`.\"* `templates/public/layout.html:25` puts the title in og:title, and og:type is `article` or `website`. That is the sensible reading of an odd spec line, but it isn't what the line says. Worth a one-line note in the closing comment.\n  3. Small mismatch in the live count (minor). The spec says *\"with a live character count\"* that matches what the server refuses. The JS (`templates/admin/_content_fields.html:27`) and the server (`app/content.py:69`) treat a few rare whitespace characters differently, so the count and the refusal can disagree by a character or two on unusual input. Normal typing is unaffected.\n  \n  **(b) Not asked for (scope creep)**\n  1. The homepage gets a meta description and og:description taken from the Homepage settings intro (`app/public_site.py:146`). The spec ties those tags to an item's Summary only. It's harmless, but it is new behaviour.\n  2. `scripts/seed_demo.py:32-90` adds new demo items (a Factbook Report and two more Data Bites), Charts built by a new `_chart` helper, and Summaries on every item. `tests/test_seed_demo.py` changes to match. None of this is in the ticket. It supports the browser check, so it's justifiable, but it should be mentioned.\n  3. Rules the spec doesn't state:\n     - The headline is required, and a Key figure needs both its value and its label (`app/homepage.py:85-101`).\n     - Line breaks and repeated spaces inside a Summary or setting are collapsed to single spaces, not just trimmed at the ends (`app/content.py:69`).\n  \n     All are reasonable, but unlisted.\n  4. Other small extras, all fine:\n     - an `updated_at` column on the homepage table\n     - a \"Homepage settings\" link on the admin home page\n     - `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` on search-index.json\n     - a fix in `tests/conftest.py` so a local `.env` can't affect tests\n  \n  **Verified correct:** a draft's title is missing from both search-index.json and search.html, and unpublishing an item removes it from the index (tested). A search from inside a Site preview redirects to the app's live `/search.html` (`app/routes/site_preview.py:36`). The search form is hidden in print (`static/site.css:289`). The Format column says PDF exactly when the Report page offers its file.\n</agent-message>"}

The homepage gets a meta description and og:description taken from the Homepage settings intro (`app/public_site.py:146`). The spec ties those tags to an item's Summary only. It's harmless, but it is new behaviour.\n  2. `scripts/seed_demo.py:32-90` adds new demo items (a Factbook Report and two more Data Bites), Charts built by a new `_chart` helper, and Summaries on every item. `tests/test_seed_demo.py` changes to match. None of this is in the ticket. It supports the browser check, so it's justifiable, but it should be mentioned.\n  3. Rules the spec doesn't state:\n     - The headline is required, and a Key figure needs both its value and its label (`app/homepage.py:85-101`).\n     - Line breaks and repeated spaces inside a Summary or setting are collapsed to single spaces, not just trimmed at the ends (`app/content.py:69`).\n  \n     All are reasonable, but unlisted.\n  4. Other small extras, all fine:\n     - an `updated_at` column on the homepage table\n     - a \"Homepage settings\" link on the admin home page\n     - `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` on search-index.json\n     - a fix in `tests/conftest.py` so a local `.env` can't affect tests\n  \n  **Verified correct:** a draft's title is missing from both search-index.json and search.html, and unpublishing an item removes it from the index (tested). A search from inside a Site preview redirects to the app's live `/search.html` (`app/routes/site_preview.py:36`). The search form is hidden in print (`static/site.css:289`).
